 const decoded = verifyRefreshToken(token);\n  if (!decoded) {\n    throw new Error('Invalid or expired refresh token signature.');\n  }\n\n  const { userId, familyId } = decoded;\n  const supabase = {\n    const isSlaveAccount = Boolean((user.master_id && !user.is_master_primary) || user.account_type === 'slave' || user.role === 'slave' || user.is_slave === true);\n    if (isSlaveAccount && !isIpAllowed(clientIp, user.whitelisted_networks)) {\n      const err = new Error('Access denied: source network is not authorized.');\n      (err as any).statusCode = 403;\n      throw err;\n    }\n  }\n\n  const tokenHash = hashToken(token);\n  const { data: storedToken, error: tokenError } = await supabase\n    .from('refresh_tokens')\n    .select('*')\n    .eq('tokenHash', tokenHash)\n    .maybeSingle();\n    \n  if (tokenError || !storedToken) {\n    throw new Error('Invalid refresh token.');\n  }\n  \n  if (storedToken.isRevoked) {\n    // Refresh token reuse detected! Revoke the whole family.\n    await supabase.from('refresh_tokens').update({ isRevoked: true }).eq('familyId', familyId);\n    throw new Error('Refresh token has been revoked.');\n  }\n  \n  if (storedToken.userId !== userId) {\n    throw new Error('Invalid refresh token ownership.');\n  }\n  \n  if (new Date(storedToken.expiresAt).getTime() < Date.now()) {\n    throw new Error('Refresh token has expired.');\n  }\n\n  // Atomic revoke the old token\n  const { data: revokedTokens, error: revokeError } = await supabase\n    .from('refresh_tokens')\n    .update({ isRevoked: true })\n    .eq('id', storedToken.id)\n    .eq('isRevoked', false)\n    .select();\n\n  if (revokeError || !revokedTokens || revokedTokens.length === 0) {\n    // Concurrent reuse detected! Revoke the whole family.\n    await supabase.from('refresh_tokens').update({ isRevoked: true }).eq('familyId', familyId);\n    throw new Error('Refresh token has already been rotated or revoked concurrently.');\n  }\n\n  const authUser = await getAuthUserForRecord(supabase, user);\n  const normalizedUser = normalizeUserRecord(user, authUser);\n  const newAccessToken = persistRefreshToken(userId, nextFamilyId, newRefreshToken);\n\n  // Auto-preserve refreshed tokens in Secret Preserver (encrypted at rest, replaces previous session tokens)\n  enrollAutoSecret(userId, rotation request by generating a token and sending a confirmation email link.\n * Password is no longer required.\n */\nexport async function requestAgentApiKeyRotation(userId: string, customAppUrl?: string) {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n\n  const { data: user, error: userError } = await supabase\n    .from('users')\n    .select('id, agentId, email, name')\n    .eq('id', userId)\n    .maybeSingle();\n\n  if (userError || !user) throw new Error('User not found.');\n\n  const authUser = await getAuthUserForRecord(supabase, user);\n  if (!authUser) throw new Error('Auth account not crypto.createHash('sha256').update(secret).digest('hex');\n  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(); // 30 minutes\n\n  // Store in auth user's app_metadata\n  const { process.env.APP_URL || config.appUrl || 'https://aamarva.com';\n  await sendApiKeyRotationEmail(user.email, token, appUrl, user.name);\n\n  return {\n    success: true,\n    message: `API key rotation confirmation link sent to ${user.email}. Please check your inbox and click the link to confirm rotation.`,\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Confirms API key rotation via token received from email link.\n * Rotates the agent's API key, revokes prior credentials, and returns the new API key.\n */\nexport async function confirmAgentApiKeyRotation(token: string) {\n  if (!token || !token.includes('.')) {\n    throw new Error('Invalid or malformed rotation token.');\n  }\n\n  const parts = token.split('.');\n  const userId = parts[0];\n  const secret = parts.slice(1).join('.');\n  const secretHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(secret).digest('hex');\n\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  const { data: user, error: userError } = await supabase\n    .from('users')\n    .select('*')\n    .eq('id', userId)\n    .maybeSingle();\n\n  if (userError || !user) throw new Error('User account not found.');\n\n  const authUser = await getAuthUserForRecord(supabase, user);\n  if (!authUser) throw new Error('Auth account not found for this user.');\n\n  const pending = authUser.app_metadata?.pendingApiKeyRotation;\n\n  if (!pending) {\n    throw new Error('No pending API key rotation request found. The link may have already been used or expired.');\n  }\n\n  const matchesHash = pending.tokenHash === secretHash || pending.tokenHash === crypto.createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex');\n  if (!matchesHash) {\n    throw new Error('Invalid or already used API key rotation token.');\n  }\n\n  if (new Date(pending.expiresAt).getTime() < Date.now()) {\n    // Clear expired token\n    await supabase.auth.admin.updateUserById(authUser.id, {\n      app_metadata: { ...authUser.app_metadata, pendingApiKeyRotation: null },\n    });\n    throw new Error('API key rotation token has expired. Please request a new rotation link.');\n  }\n\n  // Generate new API Key\n  const newApiKey = generateApiKey();\n  const apiKeyHash = await bcrypt.hash(newApiKey, 12);\n  const apiKeyFingerprint = computeApiKeyFingerprint(newApiKey);\n\n  // Update Supabase Auth app_metadata (authoritative storage) and clear pendingApiKeyRotation\n  const { error: authUpdateError } = await supabase.auth.admin.updateUserById(authUser.id, {\n    app_metadata: {\n      ...authUser.app_metadata,\n      apiKeyHash,\n      apiKeyFingerprint,\n      pendingApiKeyRotation: null,\n    },\n  });\n\n  if (authUpdateError) {\n    console.error('Failed to update apiKeyHash in Supabase Auth:', authUpdateError);\n    throw new Error('Failed to update agent credentials.');\n  }\n\n  invalidateAuthCache();\n\n  // Update the public users table apiKeyFingerprint and updatedAt for timestamp sync\n  try {\n    await supabase\n      .from('users')\n      .update({\n        apiKeyFingerprint,\n        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),\n      })\n      .eq('id', user.id);\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    console.warn('Non-fatal: Failed to update users.apiKeyFingerprint during rotation:', err.message);\n  }\n\n  invalidateAuthCache();\n\n  // Auto-preserve new rotated API key in Secret Preserver (automatically replaces previous key)\n  enrollAutoSecret(user.id, 'api_key', newApiKey).catch(() => {});\n\n  return { apiKey: newApiKey };\n}\n\n/**\n * Rotates the agent's API key.\n * Now routes either to confirmation if a token is provided, or initiates email verification link.\n */\nexport async function rotateAgentApiKey(userId: string, tokenOrPassword?: string, customAppUrl?: string) {\n  if (tokenOrPassword && tokenOrPassword.includes('.')) {\n    return await confirmAgentApiKeyRotation(tokenOrPassword);\n  }\n  return await requestAgentApiKeyRotation(userId, customAppUrl);\n}\n\n/**\n * Initiates an email change request.\n * 1. Validates new email.\n * 2. Stores hashed token in app_metadata.\n * 3. Sends verification email to the OLD address.\n */\nexport async function requestEmailChange(userId: string, data: { newEmail: string; password?: string }, customAppUrl?: string) {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  const normalizedNewEmail = normalizeEmail(data.newEmail);\n\n  if (!validateEmailFormat(normalizedNewEmail)) {\n    throw new Error('Invalid email format.');\n  }\n\n  // 1. Find current user\n  const { data: user, error: userError } = await supabase\n    .from('users')\n    .select('*')\n    .eq('id', userId)\n    .maybeSingle();\n\n  if (userError || !user) throw new Error('User not found.');\n  if (normalizeEmail(user.email) === normalizedNewEmail) {\n    throw new Error('New email is identical to current email.');\n  }\n\n  // 3. Check if new email is already taken\n  const { data: existingUser } = await supabase\n    .from('users')\n    .select('id')\n    .ilike('email', normalizedNewEmail)\n    .or('master_id.is.null,is_master_primary.eq.true')\n    .maybeSingle();\n  \n  if (existingUser) {\n    throw new Error('Email address already in use.');\n  }\n\n  // 4. Generate verification token bound to user id\n  const secret = crypto.randomBytes(32).toString('hex');\n  const token = `${user.id}.${secret}`;\n  const tokenHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(secret).digest('hex');\n  const expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 30 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(); // 30 minutes\n\n  // 5. Store in Supabase Auth app_metadata directly using user.id\n  const { data: authUserData, error: authUserErr } = await supabase.auth.admin.getUserById(user.id);\n  const authUser = authUserData?.user;\n  if (authUserErr || !authUser) throw new Error('Auth account not found.');\n\n  const { error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.admin.updateUserById(authUser.id, {\n    app_metadata: {\n      ...authUser.app_metadata,\n      pendingEmailChange: {\n        newEmail: normalizedNewEmail,\n        tokenHash,\n        expiresAt\n      }\n    }\n  });\n\n  if (updateError) throw new Error('Failed to create verification request.');\n\n  // 6. Send email to OLD address\n  const appUrl = customAppUrl || process.env.APP_URL || config.appUrl || 'https://aamarva.com';\n  await sendEmailVerification(user.email, normalizedNewEmail, token, appUrl);\n\n  return { message: 'Verification email sent to your current address.' };\n}\n\n/**\n * Verifies and applies an email change.\n */\nexport async function verifyEmailChange(token: string) {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  let targetAuthUser: any = null;\n  let pendingData: any = null;\n\n  // 1. Direct O(1) Auth user lookup via userId encoded in the verification token\n  if (token && token.includes('.')) {\n    const parts = token.split('.');\n    const userId = parts[0];\n    const secret = parts.slice(1).join('.');\n    const secretHash = crypto.createHash('sha256').update(secret).digest('hex');\n\n    const { data: authUserData, error: authUserErr } = await supabase.auth.admin.getUserById(userId);\n    if (!authUserErr && authUserData?.user) {\n      const p = authUserData.user.app_metadata?.pendingEmailChange;\n      if (p && (p.tokenHash === secretHash || p.tokenHash === crypto.createHash('sha256').update(token).digest('hex'))) {\n        targetAuthUser = authUserData.user;\n        pendingData = p;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (!targetAuthUser || !pendingData) {\n    throw new Error('Invalid or expired verification token.');\n  }\n\n  // 2. Check expiration\n  if (new Date(pendingData.expiresAt).getTime() < Date.now()) {\n    // Clear expired data\n    await supabase.auth.admin.updateUserById(targetAuthUser.id, {\n      app_metadata: { ...targetAuthUser.app_metadata, pendingEmailChange: null }\n    });\n    throw new Error('Verification token has expired.');\n  }\n\n  // 3. Final availability check (someone else might have taken it in the meantime)\n  const { data: collision } = await supabase\n    .from('users')\n    .select('id')\n    .ilike('email', pendingData.newEmail)\n    .maybeSingle();\n  \n  if (collision) {\n    throw new Error('Email address is no longer available.');\n  }\n\n  const oldEmail = targetAuthUser.email;\n\n  // 4. Atomic Update with Rollback on failure\n  // a. Update public users table\n  const { error: dbError } = await supabase\n    .from('users')\n    .update({ \n      email: pendingData.newEmail,\n      emailVerified: false,\n      emailVerifiedAt: null,\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() \n    })\n    .ilike('email', oldEmail || '');\n\n  if (dbError) throw new Error('Failed to update account record.');\n\n  // b. async function getUserConnections(userId: string, page: number, limit: number) {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n\n  // Find user profile\n  const { data: currentUser, error: userError } = await supabase\n    .from('users')\n    .select('*')\n    .eq('id', userId)\n    .maybeSingle();\n\n  if (userError || !currentUser) {\n    throw new ConnectionNotFoundError('User profile not found.', 'USER_NOT_FOUND');\n  }\n\n  const callerMasterId = currentUser.master_id && !currentUser.is_master_primary ? currentUser.master_id : currentUser.id;\n\n  // 1. Fetch Master user and all Slave accounts in the fleet\n  const [masterRes, slavesRes] = await Promise.all([\n    supabase\n      .from('users')\n      .select('id, agentId, name, avatar, emailVerified, master_id, is_master_primary')\n      .eq('id', callerMasterId)\n      .maybeSingle(),\n    supabase\n      .from('users')\n      .select('id, agentId, name, avatar, emailVerified, master_id, is_master_primary')\n      .eq('master_id', callerMasterId)\n  ]);\n\n  const masterUser = masterRes.data;\n  const slaveUsers = slavesRes.data || [];\n  const allFleetUsers: any[] = [];\n  if (masterUser) allFleetUsers.push(masterUser);\n  slaveUsers.forEach((s: any) => {\n    if (!allFleetUsers.some(u => u.id === s.id)) {\n      allFleetUsers.push(s);\n    }\n  });\n\n  const fleetUsers = allFleetUsers.filter((u: any) => u.id !== currentUser.id);\n  const fleetUserIds = new Set(allFleetUsers.map((u: any) => u.id));\n  const fleetAgentIds = new Set(allFleetUsers.map((u: any) => (u.agentId || '').toUpperCase()));\n\n  // 2. Fetch existing connections from database\n  const userAgentIdUpper = currentUser.agentId.toUpperCase();\n  const orFilter = `postOwnerUserId.eq.${currentUser.id},replyAuthorUserId.eq.${currentUser.id},postOwnerAgentId.ilike.${userAgentIdUpper},replyAuthorAgentId.ilike.${userAgentIdUpper}`;\n\n  const { data: userConnections, error: queryError } = await supabase\n    .from('connections')\n    .select('*')\n    .or(orFilter)\n    .neq('status', 'dissolved');\n\n  if (queryError) {\n    throw new ConnectionError(`Failed to retrieve user connections: ${queryError.message}`, 500, 'DATABASE_ERROR');\n  }\n\n  const rawConnections = userConnections || [];\n\n  // 3. Ensure all fleet accounts (master and slave accounts in the fleet) are included as talk targets under connections\n  const additionalFleetConnections: any[] = [];\n  for (const fUser of fleetUsers) {\n    if (!connectedPeerIds.has(fUser.id) && !connectedPeerIds.has((fUser.agentId || '').toUpperCase())) {\n      const isSlave = Boolean(fUser.master_id && fUser.master_id === callerMasterId);\n      const isMaster = Boolean(fUser.id === callerMasterId || fUser.is_master_primary);\n      const fleetConnId = `fleet_conn_${currentUser.id}_${fUser.id}`;\n\n      // Confirmed database records only. (c.replyAuthorAgentName || replyAuthor?.name || c.replyAuthorAgentId || 'Associated Agent')\n      : (c.postOwnerAgentName || postOwner?.name || c.postOwnerAgentId || 'Associated Agent');\n      \n    const peerAgentId = isUserPostOwner ? c.replyAuthorAgentId : c.postOwnerAgentId;\n    const peerAvatar = isUserPostOwner ? Boolean(replyAuthor?.emailVerified === true)\n      : Boolean(postOwner?.emailVerified === true);\n    const peerStatus = peerEmailVerified ? 'verified' : 'not verified';\n\n    const isPeerMaster = peerUser ? Boolean(peerUser.id === callerMasterId || peerUser.is_master_primary) : Boolean(c.isMaster);\n    const isPeerSlave = peerUser ? 'verified' : 'not verified';\n\n    const raVerified = Boolean(replyAuthor?.emailVerified === true);\n    const raStatus = raVerified ? 'verified' : 'not verified';\n\n    return {\n      id: c.id,\n      postId: c.postId,\n      replyId: c.replyId,\n      agentName: peerName,\n      agentId: peerAgentId,\n      peerE2eePublicKey,\n      verificationStatus: peerStatus,\n      verification_status: peerStatus,\n      [\"verification status\"]: peerStatus,\n      avatar: peerAvatar,\n      emailVerified: peerEmailVerified,\n      isHost: isUserPostOwner,\n      isMaster: isPeerMaster,\n      isSlave: isPeerSlave,\n      status: c.status || 'active',\n      connectionStatus: c.status || 'active',\n      postOwnerAgentName: c.postOwnerAgentName || postOwner?.name || 'Host Agent',\n      postOwnerAgentId: c.postOwnerAgentId,\n      postOwnerVerificationStatus: poStatus,\n      postOwnerAvatar: postOwner?.avatar || '\uD83E\uDD16',\n      postOwnerEmailVerified: poVerified,\n      replyAuthorAgentName: c.replyAuthorAgentName || replyAuthor?.name,\n      replyAuthorAgentId: c.replyAuthorAgentId,\n      replyAuthorVerificationStatus: raStatus,\n      replyAuthorAvatar: replyAuthor?.avatar || '\uD83E\uDD16',\n      replyAuthorEmailVerified: raVerified,\n      createdAt: c.createdAt,\n    };\n  });\n\n  return {\n    connections: mappedConnections,\n    total,\n    page,\n    limit,\n  };\n}\n\nexport const MAX_DECODED_CIPHERTEXT_BYTES = 102400; // 100 KiB raw decoded ciphertext\nexport const MAX_BASE64_CIPHERTEXT_LENGTH = 136536; // Math.ceil(102400 / 3) * 4 Base64 transport characters\nexport const MAX_MESSAGE_CONTENT_LENGTH = MAX_BASE64_CIPHERTEXT_LENGTH;\n\nexport interface MessagePayload {\n  content?: string;\n  message?: string;\n  ciphertext?: string;\n  nonce?: string;\n  signature?: string;\n  version?: number;\n  keyEpoch?: number;\n  sequence?: number;\n  seq?: number;\n}\n\n// Helper: strict Base64 validation\nfunction isValidBase64(str: string): boolean {\n  if (!str || typeof str !== 'string') return false;\n  const trimmed = str.trim();\n  if (trimmed.length === 0) return false;\n  const base64Regex = /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/;\n  const urlSafeRegex = /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3}=)?$/;\n  return base64Regex.test(trimmed) || urlSafeRegex.test(trimmed);\n}\n\nexport async function sendMessage(\n  connectionId: string,\n  userId: string,\n  payload: MessagePayload,\n  contextCredentials?: string[]\n) {\n  let { content, message, ciphertext, nonce, version, keyEpoch } = payload || {};\n\n  if ((content !== undefined && content !== null) || (message !== undefined && message !== null)) {\n    throw new ConnectionError(\n      'Plaintext content is strictly forbidden for private messages. AAMARVA is zero-knowledge; encryption must be performed agent-side. Remove \"content\" or \"message\" fields and provide E2EE ciphertext envelope.',\n      400,\n      'PLAINTEXT_REJECTED'\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (ciphertext === undefined || ciphertext === null || typeof ciphertext !== 'string') {\n    throw new ConnectionError(\n      'Private messages must include a valid E2EE encrypted envelope: { \"ciphertext\": \"...\", \"nonce\": \"...\", \"version\": 1, \"keyEpoch\": 1 }.',\n      400,\n      'MISSING_CIPHERTEXT'\n    );\n  }\n\n  ciphertext = ciphertext.trim();\n  if (ciphertext.length === 0) {\n    throw new ConnectionError(\n      'Ciphertext cannot be empty.',\n      400,\n      'EMPTY_CIPHERTEXT'\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (!isValidBase64(ciphertext)) {\n    throw new ConnectionError(\n      'Invalid ciphertext transport encoding. Base64-encoded ciphertext required.',\n      400,\n      'INVALID_CIPHERTEXT_ENCODING'\n    );\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const cipherBuf = Buffer.from(ciphertext, 'base64');\n    if (cipherBuf.length === 0) {\n      throw new ConnectionError(\n        'Decoded ciphertext bytes cannot be empty.',\n        400,\n        'EMPTY_CIPHERTEXT'\n      );\n    }\n  } catch (e: any) {\n    if (e instanceof ConnectionError) throw e;\n    throw new ConnectionError(\n      'Invalid ciphertext transport encoding. Base64-encoded ciphertext required.',\n      400,\n      'INVALID_CIPHERTEXT_ENCODING'\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (nonce === undefined || nonce === null || typeof nonce !== 'string') {\n    throw new ConnectionError(\n      'Private messages must include a valid Base64-encoded nonce.',\n      400,\n      'INVALID_NONCE'\n    );\n  }\n\n  nonce = nonce.trim();\n  if (nonce.length === 0 || !isValidBase64(nonce)) {\n    throw new ConnectionError(\n      'Invalid nonce encoding. Base64-encoded initialization vector required.',\n      400,\n      'INVALID_NONCE'\n    );\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const nonceBuf = Buffer.from(nonce, 'base64');\n    if (nonceBuf.length !== 12) {\n      throw new ConnectionError(\n        'Invalid nonce. AES-256-GCM requires a valid 96-bit (12-byte) initialization vector.',\n        400,\n        'INVALID_NONCE'\n      );\n    }\n  } catch (e: any) {\n    if (e instanceof ConnectionError) throw e;\n    throw new ConnectionError(\n      'Invalid nonce encoding. Base64-encoded initialization vector required.',\n      400,\n      'INVALID_NONCE'\n    );\n  }\n\n  if (payload.version !== undefined && payload.version !== null) {\n    if (typeof payload.version !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(payload.version) || !Number.isInteger(payload.version) || payload.version !== 1) {\n      throw new ConnectionError(\n        'Unsupported E2EE protocol version. Only version 1 is supported.',\n        400,\n        'UNSUPPORTED_VERSION'\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  if (payload.keyEpoch !== undefined && payload.keyEpoch !== null) {\n    if (typeof payload.keyEpoch !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(payload.keyEpoch) || !Number.isInteger(payload.keyEpoch) || payload.keyEpoch < 1) {\n      throw new ConnectionError(\n        'Invalid keyEpoch.     }\n        return ev.user_id === targetUser.id || details?.user_id === targetUser.id || details?.agent_id === targetUser.agentId;\n      });\n\n      const slaveHistory = slaveEvents.map((ev: any) Fetch the target agent record\n    const { data: targetUser, error: fetchErr } = await supabase\n      .from('users')\n      .select('*')\n      .or(`id.eq.${targetAgentId},agentId.eq.${targetAgentId}`)\n      .maybeSingle();\n\n    if (fetchErr || !targetUser) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Target agent not found.' } });\n    }\n\n    // 2. GET /api/agents/me (View own agent profile)\nrouter.get('/agents/me', requireUserOrAgentAuth, securityLayer('public_reads'), async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {\n  try {\n    const profile = await getAgentProfile(req.user!.agentId, true);\n    if (profile) {\n      const { id, ...profileWithoutId } = profile as any;\n      return res.json({ success: true, data: profileWithoutId });\n    }\n    res.json({ success: true, data: profile });\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { message: err.message } });\n  }\n});\n\n// In-memory cache to eliminate repetitive auth.admin.getUserById roundtrips across routes\nconst authRecordCache = new Map<string, { user: any; timestamp: number }>();\nconst AUTH_RECORD_CACHE_TTL_MS = 15000;\n\n// Helper to guarantee an auth.users record exists for any database agent (including slave agents)\nasync function ensureAuthUserRecord(supabase: any, userId: string): Promise<any> {\n  if (!userId) return null;\n  const now = Date.now();\n  const cached = authRecordCache.get(userId);\n  if (cached && (now - cached.timestamp < AUTH_RECORD_CACHE_TTL_MS)) {\n    return cached.user;\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const { data: authData, error: authErr } = await supabase.auth.admin.getUserById(userId);\n    if (!authErr && authData?.user) {\n      authRecordCache.set(userId, { user: authData.user, timestamp: now });\n      return authData.user;\n    }\n    const { data: dbUser } = await supabase.from('users').select('*').eq('id', userId).maybeSingle();\n    if (!dbUser) return null;\n\n    const email = dbUser.email || `${(dbUser.agentId || 'agent').toLowerCase()}@aamarva.net`;\n    const { data: created, error: createErr } = await supabase.auth.admin.createUser({\n      id: dbUser.id,\n      email,\n      email_confirm: true,\n      user_metadata: {\n        agentId: dbUser.agentId,\n        name: dbUser.name,\n        avatar: dbUser.avatar,\n        bio: dbUser.bio\n      }\n    });\n\n    if (!createErr && created?.user) {\n      return created.user;\n    }\n\n    const { data: refetched } = await supabase.auth.admin.getUserById(userId);\n    return refetched?.user || null;\n  } catch (err) {\n    console.warn('ensureAuthUserRecord notice:', err);\n    return null;\n  }\n}\n\n// 5b-2. GET /api/agents/me/e2ee (Retrieve Registered E2EE Public Key & Fingerprint)\nrouter.get('/agents/me/e2ee', requireUserOrAgentAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {\n  try {\n    const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n    const authUser = await ensureAuthUserRecord(supabase, req.user!.id);\n    const meta = authUser?.user_metadata || {};\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: {\n        publicKey: meta.e2eePublicKey || null,\n        fingerprint: meta.e2eePublicKeyFingerprint || null,\n        identityKey: meta.e2eeIdentityKey || null,\n        keyEpoch: meta.e2eeKeyEpoch || 1,\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { message: err.message } });\n  }\n});\n\n// 5c. PUT /api/agents/me/e2ee (Upload E2EE Public Key with Authenticated Identity Binding)\nrouter.put('/agents/me/e2ee', requireUserOrAgentAuth, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {\n  try {\n    const { publicKey, fingerprint, identityKey, signature, allowRotation, keyEpoch } = req.body;\n    if (!publicKey) throw new Error('Public key is required.');\n\n    const parsedEpoch = typeof keyEpoch === 'number' && keyEpoch > 0 ? keyEpoch : 1;\n\n    // Cryptographic validation of public key JWK (ECDH NIST P-256)\n    let parsedJwk: any;\n    try {\n      parsedJwk = typeof publicKey === 'string' ? JSON.parse(publicKey) : publicKey;\n    } catch {\n      res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Invalid public key format. Valid JWK required.' } });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    if (parsedJwk.kty !== 'EC' || parsedJwk.crv !== 'P-256' || !parsedJwk.x || !parsedJwk.y) {\n      res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Public key must be a valid ECDH NIST P-256 JWK.' } });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Canonical fingerprint computation matching src/lib/e2ee.ts (colon-delimited SHA256)\n    const canonicalJwk = JSON.stringify({ crv: parsedJwk.crv || 'P-256', kty: parsedJwk.kty || 'EC', x: parsedJwk.x, y: parsedJwk.y });\n    const digestHex = nodeCrypto.createHash('sha256').update(canonicalJwk).digest('hex').toUpperCase();\n    const computedFingerprint = 'SHA256:' + (digestHex.match(/.{2}/g)?.join(':') || digestHex);\n\n    // Authenticated Identity Key Binding Verification (ECDSA P-256)\n    let parsedIdentityJwk: any = null;\n    let identityKeyStr: string | null = null;\n    if (identityKey) {\n      try {\n        parsedIdentityJwk = typeof identityKey === 'string' ? JSON.parse(identityKey) : identityKey;\n      } catch {\n        res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Invalid identity key format. Valid JWK required.' } });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      if (parsedIdentityJwk.kty !== 'EC' || parsedIdentityJwk.crv !== 'P-256' || !parsedIdentityJwk.x || !parsedIdentityJwk.y) {\n        res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Identity key must be a valid ECDSA NIST P-256 JWK.' } });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      identityKeyStr = typeof identityKey === 'string' ? identityKey : JSON.stringify(identityKey);\n\n      // Verify the cryptographic signature over the canonical binding statement\n      if (!signature || typeof signature !== 'string') {\n        res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Identity signature is required when providing an identity key.' } });\n        return;\n      }\n\n      try {\n        const canonicalAgentId = req.user!.agentId.toUpperCase();\n        const bindingStatement = new TextEncoder().encode(`AAMARVA-KEY-BINDING:v1:${canonicalAgentId}:${computedFingerprint}`);\n        const importedIdKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey(\n          'jwk',\n          parsedIdentityJwk,\n          { name: 'ECDSA', namedCurve: 'P-256' },\n          true,\n          ['verify']\n        );\n        const sigBuffer = Buffer.from(signature, 'base64');\n        const isSigValid = await crypto.subtle.verify(\n          { name: 'ECDSA', hash: 'SHA-256' },\n          importedIdKey,\n          sigBuffer,\n          bindingStatement\n        );\n\n        if (!isSigValid) {\n          res.status(400).json({\n            success: false,\n            error: {\n              code: 'INVALID_KEY_SIGNATURE',\n              message: 'Cryptographic identity binding verification failed. Signature does not match identity key and agent ID.'\n            }\n          });\n          return;\n        }\n      } catch (verErr: any) {\n        res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          error: {\n            code: 'INVALID_KEY_SIGNATURE',\n            message: `Cryptographic identity verification error: ${verErr.message}`\n          }\n        });\n        return;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n    const authUser = await ensureAuthUserRecord(supabase, req.user!.id);\n    if (!authUser) {\n      console.warn('User account not found for E2EE key update:', req.user!.id);\n      res.status(404).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'USER_NOT_FOUND',\n          message: 'User account not found.'\n        }\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const userDataMeta = authUser.user_metadata || {};\n    const existingFp = userDataMeta.e2eePublicKeyFingerprint;\n    const existingIdKey = userDataMeta.e2eeIdentityKey;\n\n    const isRotationAuthorized = allowRotation === true || allowRotation === 'true' || allowRotation === 1;\n\n    // Prevent silent key replacement / substitution if key already exists and rotation is not authorized\n    if (existingFp && existingFp !== computedFingerprint && !isRotationAuthorized) {\n      res.status(409).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'KEY_ROTATION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED',\n          message: 'An E2EE public key is already registered for this identity. Explicit key rotation authorization is required to replace it.'\n        }\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Prevent unauthorized replacement of identity signing key\n    if (existingIdKey && identityKeyStr && existingIdKey !== identityKeyStr && !isRotationAuthorized) {\n      res.status(409).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'IDENTITY_KEY_IMMUTABLE',\n          message: 'Agent identity key is permanently bound to this agent. Explicit key rotation authorization is required to re-bind identity.'\n        }\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const pubKeyStr = typeof publicKey === 'string' ? publicKey : JSON.stringify(publicKey);\n    const existingEpochHistory = (userDataMeta.e2eeEpochHistory as Record<string, any>) || {};\n    \n    // Strict epoch immutability check: Never overwrite an existing epoch with a different key\n    const existingEpochEntry = existingEpochHistory[String(parsedEpoch)];\n    if (existingEpochEntry && existingEpochEntry.fingerprint && existingEpochEntry.fingerprint !== computedFingerprint) {\n      res.status(409).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'E2EE_EPOCH_ALREADY_EXISTS',\n          message: `Key epoch ${parsedEpoch} already exists with a different cryptographic key. Historical key epochs are immutable and cannot be overwritten.`\n        }\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    existingEpochHistory[String(parsedEpoch)] = {\n      publicKey: pubKeyStr,\n      fingerprint: computedFingerprint,\n      keyEpoch: parsedEpoch,\n      identityKey: identityKeyStr,\n      signature: signature,\n      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()\n    };\n\n    const updatedMetadata = {\n      ...userDataMeta,\n      e2eePublicKey: pubKeyStr,\n      e2eePublicKeyFingerprint: computedFingerprint,\n      e2eeKeyEpoch: parsedEpoch,\n      e2eeEpochHistory: existingEpochHistory,\n      ...(identityKeyStr ? { e2eeIdentityKey: identityKeyStr } : {}),\n      ...(signature ? { e2eeKeySignature: signature } : {}),\n      e2eeKeyUpdatedAt: new Date().toISOString()\n    };\n\n    const { error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.admin.updateUserById(req.user!.id, {\n      user_metadata: updatedMetadata\n    });\n\n    if (updateError) {\n      console.warn('Failed to persist E2EE key metadata to auth user:', updateError.message);\n      res.status(500).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'E2EE_KEY_PERSISTENCE_FAILED',\n          message: 'Failed to persist E2EE key metadata.'\n        }\n      });\n      return;\n    }\n\n    authRecordCache.delete(req.user!.id);\n\n    try {\n      watchtowerActivityService.recordWatchtowerActivity({\n        agentId: req.user!.agentId || req.user!.id,\n        agentName: req.user!.name,\n        avatar: req.user!.avatar,\n        emailVerified: req.user!.emailVerified,\n        text: 'registered its E2EE cryptographic identity',\n        type: 'E2EE_KEYS_UPDATED',\n        actorUserId: req.user!.id,\n        masterId: req.user!.masterId || req.user!.id,\n        activityKey: `e2ee_keys:${req.user!.id}:${parsedEpoch}`\n      }).catch(console.warn);\n      (req as any).alreadyRecordedSlaveActivity = true;\n    } catch {}\n\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: {\n        fingerprint: computedFingerprint,\n        keyEpoch: parsedEpoch,\n        hasIdentityBinding: !!identityKeyStr\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: err.message } });\n  }\n});\n\n// 5d. GET /api/agents/me/e2ee/recovery (Retrieve Encrypted Recovery Artifact for Multi-Device E2EE Sync - Human Session Only)\nrouter.get('/agents/me/e2ee/recovery', requireHumanSession, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {\n  try {\n    const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n    const authUser = await ensureAuthUserRecord(supabase, req.user!.id);\n    if (!authUser) {\n      return res.status(404).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'User not found.' } });\n    }\n    const metadata = authUser.user_metadata || {};\n\n    res.json({\n      success: true,\n      data: {\n        recoveryVault: metadata.e2eeRecoveryVault || null,\n        publicKey: metadata.e2eePublicKey || null,\n        fingerprint: metadata.e2eePublicKeyFingerprint || null,\n        keyEpoch: metadata.e2eeKeyEpoch || 1,\n        epochHistory: metadata.e2eeEpochHistory || null\n      }\n    });\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: { message: err.message || 'Failed to retrieve recovery vault.' } });\n  }\n});\n\n// Helper for strict Base64 validation\nfunction isValidBase64(str: string): boolean {\n  if (!str || typeof str !== 'string') return false;\n  const trimmed = str.trim();\n  if (trimmed.length === 0) return false;\n  const base64Regex = /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9+/]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9+/]{3}=)?$/;\n  const urlSafeRegex = /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{4})*(?:[A-Za-z0-9_-]{2}==|[A-Za-z0-9_-]{3}=)?$/;\n  return base64Regex.test(trimmed) || urlSafeRegex.test(trimmed);\n}\n\n// 5e. PUT /api/agents/me/e2ee/recovery (Upload Encrypted Recovery Artifact - Human Session Only, Strict Transport Validation)\nrouter.put('/agents/me/e2ee/recovery', requireHumanSession, async (req: AuthenticatedRequest, res: Response) => {\n  try {\n    const { recoveryVault } = req.body;\n    if (!recoveryVault || typeof recoveryVault !== 'object') {\n      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Valid recoveryVault object is required.' } });\n    }\n\n    const { ciphertext, nonce, version, kdfVersion } = recoveryVault;\n    if (!ciphertext || typeof ciphertext !== 'string' || !nonce || typeof nonce !== 'string') {\n      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'ciphertext and nonce strings are required in recoveryVault.' } });\n    }\n\n    // Strict transport validation: Base64 and max size checks\n    if (!isValidBase64(ciphertext)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Invalid ciphertext transport encoding. Base64 required.' } });\n    }\n\n    if (ciphertext.length > 131072) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Recovery payload exceeds maximum allowed size (128KB).' } });\n    }\n\n    if (!isValidBase64(nonce)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Invalid nonce encoding. Base64 required.' } });\n    }\n\n    try {\n      const nonceBuf = Buffer.from(nonce, 'base64');\n      if (nonceBuf.length !== 12) {\n        return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Invalid nonce. AES-256-GCM requires exactly 12 bytes (96 bits).' } });\n      }\n    } catch {\n      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Invalid nonce decoding.' } });\n    }\n\n    const parsedVersion = version !== undefined ? Number(version) : 1;\n    if (!Number.isInteger(parsedVersion) || (parsedVersion !== 1 && parsedVersion !== 2)) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { message: 'Unsupported recovery-vault version.' } });\n    }\n\n    const parsedKdfVersion = kdfVersion !== undefined ? AES-256-GCM requires a valid 96-bit (12-byte) initialization vector.',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n    } catch {\n      return res.status(400).json({\n        success: false,\n        error: {\n          code: 'INVALID_NONCE',\n          message: 'Invalid nonce encoding. Strict version validation (only version 1 is supported)\n    let parsedVersion = 1;\n    if (version !== undefined && version !== null) {\n      if (typeof version !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(version) || !Number.isInteger(version) || version !== 1) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          error: {\n            code: 'UNSUPPORTED_VERSION',\n            message: 'Unsupported E2EE protocol version. Only version 1 is supported.',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n      parsedVersion = version;\n    }\n\n    // 6. Strict keyEpoch validation (positive integer when supplied)\n    let parsedKeyEpoch = 1;\n    if (keyEpoch !== undefined && keyEpoch !== null) {\n      if (typeof keyEpoch !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(keyEpoch) || !Number.isInteger(keyEpoch) || keyEpoch < 1) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          error: {\n            code: 'INVALID_KEY_EPOCH',\n            message: 'Invalid keyEpoch. When supplied, keyEpoch must be a positive integer (>= 1). Malformed, non-numeric, decimal, or negative values are rejected.',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n      parsedKeyEpoch = keyEpoch;\n    }\n\n    // 7. Strict sequence validation (non-negative integer when supplied)\n    let parsedSequence: number | undefined = undefined;\n    const rawSeq = sequence ?? seq;\n    if (rawSeq !== undefined && rawSeq !== null) {\n      if (typeof rawSeq !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(rawSeq) || !Number.isInteger(rawSeq) || rawSeq < 0) {\n        return res.status(400).json({\n          success: false,\n          error: {\n            code: 'INVALID_SEQUENCE',\n            message: 'Invalid sequence. When supplied, sequence must be a non-negative integer (>= 0).',\n          },\n        });\n      }\n      parsedSequence = rawSeq;\n    }\n\n    // 8. Sanity limits (100 KiB raw decoded max = 102,400 bytes = 136,536 Base64 transport characters)\n    if (trimmedCiphertext.length > MAX_BASE64_CIPHERTEXT_LENGTH) {\n      return res.status(400).json({ success: false, error: { code: 'PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE', message: 'Ciphertext exceeds maximum allowed payload size (100 KiB / 102,400 bytes).' } });\n    }\n\n    const contextCreds = extractRequestContextCredentials(req);\n    \n    const message: any = await sendMessage(\n      connRecord.id,\n      req.user!.id,\n      {\n        ciphertext: trimmedCiphertext,\n        nonce: trimmedNonce,\n        version: parsedVersion,\n        keyEpoch: parsedKeyEpoch,\n        sequence: parsedSequence,\n      },\n      contextCreds\n    );\n\n    // Log outbound footprint for sender\n    try {\n      await logAgentFootprint(\n        req.user!.id,\n        'MESSAGE_SENT',\n        'Private message sent',\n        message.id\n      );\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('Failed to log message footprint:', e);\n    }\n\n    // Broadcast to Watchtower (deliberate meaningful fleet event)\n    try {\n      const isPostOwner = (connRecord.postOwnerUserId && connRecord.postOwnerUserId === req.user!.id) || \n                          (req.user!.agentId && connRecord.postOwnerAgentId?.toLowerCase() === req.user!.agentId.toLowerCase());\n      const peerUserId = isPostOwner ? connRecord.replyAuthorUserId : connRecord.postOwnerUserId;\n      const peerAgentId = isPostOwner ? connRecord.replyAuthorAgentId : connRecord.postOwnerAgentId;\n      const cleanPeerDisplay = (peerAgentId || (connRecord as any)?.receiverAgentId || peerAccountId || 'peer').replace(/^@+/, '');\n\n      watchtowerActivityService.recordWatchtowerActivity({\n        agentId: req.user!.agentId || req.user!.id,\n        agentName: req.user!.name,\n        avatar: req.user!.avatar,\n        emailVerified: req.user!.emailVerified,\n        text: `transmitted encrypted transmission to @${cleanPeerDisplay}`,\n        type: 'MESSAGE_SENT',\n        peerName: cleanPeerDisplay,\n        peerAgentId: peerAgentId || peerAccountId,\n        peerUserId: peerUserId || undefined,\n        actorUserId: req.user!.id,\n        masterId: req.user!.masterId || req.user!.id,\n        entityId: message.id,\n        activityKey: `msg_sent:${message.id}`\n      }).catch(console.warn);\n      (req as any).alreadyRecordedSlaveActivity = true;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.warn('Watchtower message activity broadcast error:', e);\n    }\n\n    // Log inbound external event for recipient\n    try {\n      const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n      const { data: conn } = await sb\n        .from('connections')\n        .select('postOwnerUserId, replyAuthorUserId')\n        .eq('id', connRecord.id)\n        .maybeSingle();\n\n      if (conn) {\n        const recipientUserId = conn.postOwnerUserId === req.user!.id ? conn.replyAuthorUserId : conn.postOwnerUserId;\n        if (recipientUserId) {\n          await logExternalEvent(\n            recipientUserId,\n            'MESSAGE_RECEIVED',\n            message.senderAgentId || req.user!.agentId,\n            message.id\n          );\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('Failed to log message external event:', e);\n    }\n\n    res.status(201).json({ \n      success: true, \n      data: {\n        id: message.id,\n        messageId: message.id,\n        connectionId: message.connectionId,\n        senderAgentId: message.senderAgentId,\n        content: null,\n        ciphertext: message.ciphertext,\n        nonce: message.nonce,\n        version: message.version,\n        keyEpoch: message.keyEpoch || 1,\n        createdAt: message.createdAt\n      } \n    });\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    console.error('Route handler error [POST /api/connections/:connectionId/messages]:', err);\n    const status = err.statusCode || (err.message.includes('Forbidden') ? Master.\n   */\n  private async checkCapabilityIncrement(userId: string): Promise<boolean> {\n    if (!userId) return false;\n    \n    try {\n      const masterService = MasterAccountService.getInstance();\n      \n      // Determine if requesting account is a Master primary or a Slave\n      let metadata = masterService.getUserMetadata(userId);\n      if (!metadata) capService.isAgentCapabilityActive(metadata.id);\n      }\n\n      return false;\n    } catch (e) {\n      console.error('[SECURITY] Individual slave capability check failed:', e);\n      return false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  public async evaluateRequest(req: Request, policyName: string, userId?: string, trafficClass: TrafficClass = TrafficClass.PUBLIC): Promise<void> {\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyName];\n    if (!policy) {\n      console.error(`[SECURITY] Attempted to evaluate nonexistent policy: ${policyName}`);\n      throw new               const payload = await verifyHumanSession(sessionCookie);\n                if (payload) effectiveUserId = payload.id;\n            } else if (apiKey) {\n                 // Agent API key     effectiveUserId = req.body.agentId || req.body.email || req.body.userId;\n    }\n\n    // CHECK CAPABILITY INCREMENT\n    let isCapabilityIncrement = false;\n    if (effectiveUserId) {\n      isCapabilityIncrement = await this.checkCapabilityIncrement(effectiveUserId);\n    }\n\n    const identifier = policy.identity === 'account' \n      ? effectiveUserId \n      : (policy.identity === required for security verification.');\n    }\n\n    // 1. Check existing enforcements (Bans/Suspensions)\n    await this.checkEnforcements(identifier as string, policyName, policy.isCritical, trafficClass);\n\n    // 2. Resource Protection Validation (Always Fail-Closed)\n    this.validateResourceLimits(req, policy);\n\n    // 3. Correlation Scrutiny (Priority 14: Cross-account abuse evasion)\n    await this.performCorrelationCheck(ipStr, effectiveUserId, policy.isCritical, trafficClass);\n\n    // 4. Rate Limiting & Quota (Deterministic Window-based, Atomic)\n    // Defense-in-Depth: Always perform an IP-based check as an abuse-defense layer for non-public traffic\n    if (policy.identity === 'account' && trafficClass !== TrafficClass.PUBLIC) {\n      await this.checkRateLimit(ipStr, `ip_defense:${policyName}`, ipStr, false, trafficClass, { windowMs: 60000, max: 100 }); // Generic high-burst IP defense\n    }\n\n    if (policy.quota || policy.resourceConstraints) {\n      await this.checkQuota(identifier as string, policyName, ipStr, policy.isCritical, trafficClass, isCapabilityIncrement, req);\n    } else {\n      await this.checkRateLimit(identifier as string, policyName, ipStr, policy.isCritical, trafficClass, undefined, isCapabilityIncrement, req);\n    }\n\n    // 5. Track Activity\n    await this.trackActivity(identifier as string, policyName);\n  }\n\n  private async performCorrelationCheck(ip: string, userId: string | undefined, isCritical: boolean = false, trafficClass: TrafficClass = TrafficClass.PUBLIC): Promise<void> {\n    if (!userId || !this.tableExistence.security_enforcement_events) return;\n    const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n    \n    // Check if this IP has other suspended/banned accounts (Priority 14)\n    const { data: correlatedAbuse, error } = await sb\n      .from('security_enforcement_events')\n      .select('identifier')\n      .eq('ip', ip)\n      .neq('identifier', userId)\n      .in('eventType', ['SUSPENSION', 'BAN'])\n      .gt('timestamp', new Date(Date.now() - 48 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()) // Last 48h\n      .limit(1);\n\n    if (error) {\n      if (this.handleTableError('security_enforcement_events', error, isCritical, trafficClass)) return;\n      console.error('[SECURITY CORRELATION ERROR]', error);\n      throw new SecurityError('INTERNAL_SECURITY_ERROR', 'Security verification failed. Access denied.');\n    }\n\n    if (correlatedAbuse && correlatedAbuse.length > 0) {\n      console.warn(`[SECURITY CORRELATION] Account ${userId} correlated with abusive IP ${ip}`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  public normalizeIp(ip: string): string {\n    if (!ip || ip === '::1' || ip === '127.0.0.1') return '127.0.0.1';\n    \n    let normalized = ip;\n    \n    // Handle IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses (e.g., ::ffff:127.0.0.1)\n    if (normalized.startsWith('::ffff:')) {\n      normalized = normalized.substring(7);\n    }\n    \n    // For general IPv6, use a standard library or normalize to lowercase\n    // We strictly use canonical representation for equality checks\n    if (normalized.includes(':')) {\n      // Simple IPv6 normalization for equality in DB\n      return normalized.toLowerCase().trim();\n    }\n\n    // Check if it's a valid IP\n    if (!isIP(normalized)) {\n      return 'unknown';\n    }\n\n    return normalized.trim();\n  }\n\n  public checkPayloadDepth(obj: any, currentDepth: number, maxDepth: number): void {\n    if (currentDepth > maxDepth) {\n      throw new Error(`Payload depth exceeded maximum limit of ${maxDepth}`);\n    }\n\n    if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Handle arrays\n    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {\n      if (obj.length > 1000) throw new Error('Array length limit exceeded in payload');\n      for (const item of obj) {\n        this.checkPayloadDepth(item, currentDepth + 1, maxDepth);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Handle objects\n    const keys = Object.keys(obj);\n    if (keys.length > 100) throw new Error('Object key limit exceeded in payload');\n    \n    for (const key of keys) {\n      this.checkPayloadDepth(obj[key], currentDepth + 1, maxDepth);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async checkQuota(identifier: string, policyName: string, ip: string, isCritical: boolean = false, trafficClass: TrafficClass = TrafficClass.PUBLIC, isCapabilityIncrement: boolean = false, req?: Request): Promise<void> {\n    const isLoopback = ip === '127.0.0.1' || ip === '::1' || ip === '::ffff:127.0.0.1' || ip === 'localhost';\n    if 'GET') {\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyName];\n    if (!policy) return;\n\n    const now = new Date();\n    \n    // Use capability limits if applicable\n
