// /hour\n      };\n      if (capabilityLimits[policyName]) {\n        limitMax = capabilityLimits[policyName];\n      }\n    }\n\n    const windowStartMs = Math.floor(now.getTime() / policy.rateLimit.windowMs) * policy.rateLimit.windowMs;\n    const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1);\n    const dayStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), now.getDate());\n\n    if (this.tableExistence.check_cluster_quota_atomic) {\n      try {\n        const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n        const { data: result, error } = await sb.rpc('check_cluster_quota_atomic', {\n          p_identifier: identifier,\n          p_endpoint: policyName,\n          p_window_start: new Date(windowStartMs).toISOString(),\n          p_max_burst: limitMax,\n          p_month_start: monthStart.toISOString(),\n          p_max_monthly: policy.quota?.monthly || 1000000,\n          p_day_start: dayStart.toISOString(),\n          p_max_daily: policy.quota?.daily || 1000000,\n          p_resource_table: policy.resourceConstraints?.table,\n          p_resource_owner_col: policy.resourceConstraints?.ownerCol,\n          p_resource_max: policy.resourceConstraints?.max,\n          p_resource_status_col: policy.resourceConstraints?.statusCol,\n          p_resource_active_status: policy.resourceConstraints?.activeStatus\n        });\n\n        if (!error && result) {\n          if (!result.success) {\n            if (result.error === 'RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED') {\n              throw new SecurityError('FORBIDDEN', result.message);\n            }\n            if (result.error === 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED') {\n              throw new SecurityError('RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', result.message, (windowStartMs + policy.rateLimit.windowMs - now.getTime()).toString());\n            }\n            if (result.error === 'MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED') {\n              throw new SecurityError('MONTHLY_QUOTA_EXCEEDED', 'Monthly quota exceeded. Access denied until next month.');\n            }\n            if (result.error === 'DAILY_PACING_EXCEEDED') {\n              throw new SecurityError('RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', 'Daily pacing target exceeded. Please try again tomorrow.');\n            }\n          }\n          return;\n        }\n\n        if (error) {\n          const isHandled = this.handleTableError('check_cluster_quota_atomic', error, isCritical, trafficClass);\n          if (!isHandled && (isCritical || policy.quota || policy.resourceConstraints)) {\n            throw new SecurityError('DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE', 'Security verification service temporarily unavailable.');\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        if (e instanceof SecurityError) throw e;\n        this.tableExistence.check_cluster_quota_atomic = false;\n        if (isCritical || policy.quota || policy.resourceConstraints) {\n          throw new SecurityError('DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE', 'Security verification service temporarily unavailable.');\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // STRICT FAIL-CLOSED: No local fallback allowed for authoritative cluster quotas\n    if (this.tableExistence.check_cluster_quota_atomic && (policy.quota || policy.resourceConstraints)) {\n      throw new SecurityError('DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE', 'Security verification service temporarily unavailable.');\n    }\n\n    await this.checkRateLimit(identifier, policyName, ip, isCritical, trafficClass, undefined, isCapabilityIncrement, req);\n  }\n\n  private async checkRateLimit(identifier: string, policyName: string, ip: string, isCritical: boolean = false, trafficClass: TrafficClass = TrafficClass.PUBLIC, customLimit?: { windowMs: number, max: number }, isCapabilityIncrement: boolean = false, req?: Request): Promise<void> {\n    const isLoopback = ip === '127.0.0.1' || ip === '::1' || ip === '::ffff:127.0.0.1' || ip === 'localhost';\n    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test' || isLoopback) {\n      return;\n    }\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyName];\n    let limit = customLimit || (policy ? { ...policy.rateLimit } : { windowMs: 60000, max: 100 });\n\n    // Capability Increment Rate-Limit Upgrade\n    if (isCapabilityIncrement && policyName !== 'public_reads') {\n      const capabilityLimits: Record<string, { windowMs: number, max: number }> = {\n        'post_create': { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 120 },\n        'reply_create': { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 300 },\n        'message_create': { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 600 },\n        'cluster_create': { windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000, max: 10 },\n        'cluster_list': { windowMs: 60 * 1000, max: 300 },\n        'cluster_get': { windowMs: 60 * 1000, max: 300 },\n        'cluster_update': { windowMs: 60 * 1000, max: 60 },\n        'cluster_join': { windowMs: 60 * 60 * 1000, max: 20 },\n        'cluster_member_role_update': { windowMs: 60 * 1000, max: 30 },\n        'cluster_message_create': { windowMs: 60 * 1000, max: 300 },\n        'cluster_message_list': { windowMs: 60 * 1000, max: 600 },\n        'cluster_member_kick': { windowMs: 60 * 1000, max: 30 },\n        'cluster_leave': { windowMs: 60 * 1000, max: 30 },\n        'agent_update': { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 60 },\n      };\n      if (capabilityLimits[policyName]) {\n        limit = capabilityLimits[policyName];\n      }\n      if (policyName === 'connection_request' && req) {\n        limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 60 };\n      }\n    } else if (isCapabilityIncrement && policyName === 'public_reads' && req) {\n        // Path-based enforcement for public_reads\n        const originalUrlNoApi = req.originalUrl.startsWith('/api') ? req.originalUrl.substring(4) : req.originalUrl;\n        const cleanPath = originalUrlNoApi.split('?')[0].replace(/\\/$/, '');\n\n        if (cleanPath === '/connections/recent') {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 300 };\n        } else if (cleanPath === '/connection-requests/recent') {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 300 };\n        } else if (cleanPath.startsWith('/connections/') && cleanPath.endsWith('/messages')) {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 1200 };\n        } else if (cleanPath === '/connections') {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 600 };\n        } else if (cleanPath.startsWith('/posts/') && cleanPath.endsWith('/replies')) {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 1000 };\n        } else if (cleanPath === '/posts') {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 1000 };\n        } else if (/^\\/posts\\/[^/]+$/.test(cleanPath)) {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 600 };\n        } else if (cleanPath === '/replies') {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 600 };\n        } else if (cleanPath === '/agents') {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 1000 };\n        } else if (/^\\/agents\\/[^/]+$/.test(cleanPath) && cleanPath !== '/agents/me') {\n          limit = { windowMs: 1 * 60 * 1000, max: 600 };\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Enforce user custom reduced rate limit if set (strictly <= default policy max)\n    if (identifier && policy) {\n      const userCustomLimits = this.getUserCustomRateLimits(identifier);\n      if (userCustomLimits && typeof userCustomLimits[policyName] === 'number') {\n        const customMax = Math.floor(userCustomLimits[policyName]);\n        if (customMax >= 1 && customMax < limit.max) {\n          limit = { windowMs: limit.windowMs, max: customMax };\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    const now = Date.now();\n    const windowStartMs = Math.floor(now / limit.windowMs) * limit.windowMs;\n\n    if (this.tableExistence.check_rate_limit_atomic) {\n      try {\n        const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n        const windowStart = new Date(windowStartMs);\n        const { data: result, error } = await sb.rpc('check_rate_limit_atomic', {\n          p_identifier: identifier,\n          p_endpoint: policyName,\n          p_window_start: windowStart.toISOString(),\n          p_max_requests: limit.max\n        });\n\n        if (!error && result) {\n          if (result.exceeded) {\n            await this.recordRateLimitEvent(identifier, policyName, result.requestCount, ip);\n            throw new SecurityError(\n              'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', \n              `Rate limit exceeded for ${policy?.endpoint || policyName}. Max: ${limit.max} per ${limit.windowMs / 1000}s`, \n              (windowStart.getTime() + limit.windowMs - now).toString()\n            );\n          }\n          return;\n        }\n\n        if (error) {\n          this.handleTableError('check_rate_limit_atomic', error, isCritical, trafficClass);\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        if (e.code === 'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED') throw e;\n        this.tableExistence.check_rate_limit_atomic = false;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // In-memory rate limiting fallback for testing and development\n    const key = `${identifier}:${policyName}`;\n    const current = this.localRateLimitMap.get(key);\n    let currentCount = 1;\n    if (current && current.windowStart === windowStartMs) {\n      currentCount = current.count + 1;\n    }\n    this.localRateLimitMap.set(key, { count: currentCount, windowStart: windowStartMs });\n\n    if (currentCount > limit.max) {\n      throw new SecurityError(\n        'RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', \n        `Rate limit exceeded for ${policy?.endpoint || policyName}. Max: ${limit.max} per ${limit.windowMs / 1000}s`, \n        (windowStartMs + limit.windowMs - now).toString()\n      );\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async recordRateLimitEvent(identifier: string, policyName: string, count: number, ip: string): Promise<void> {\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyName];\n    const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n    \n    // Log the event\n    await this.logEnforcementEvent({\n      identifier,\n      policyKey: policyName,\n      endpoint: policy.endpoint,\n      eventType: 'RATE_LIMIT_VIOLATION',\n      severity: SecuritySeverity.S1_SUSPICIOUS,\n      reason: `Rate limit hit: ${count}/${policy.rateLimit.max}`,\n      ip\n    });\n\n    if (!this.tableExistence.security_enforcement_events) return;\n\n    // Check if this identifier has repeated rate limit violations\n    const { count: violationCount, error } = await sb\n      .from('security_enforcement_events')\n      .select('*', { count: 'exact', head: true })\n      .eq('identifier', identifier)\n      .eq('eventType', 'RATE_LIMIT_VIOLATION')\n      .gt('timestamp', new Date(Date.now() - 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString()); // Last 24h\n\n    if (error) {\n      console.error('[SECURITY] Error checking rate limit violations history:', error);\n      return; // Non-critical for decision, but logged\n    }\n\n    if (violationCount && violationCount > 10) {\n      // Escalating repeated 429s into a strike\n      await this.recordViolation(identifier, '', policyName, SecuritySeverity.S2_ABUSE, `Persistent rate limit abuse: ${violationCount} violations in 24h`, ip);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async checkIpReputation(ip: string, isCritical: boolean = false, trafficClass: TrafficClass = TrafficClass.PUBLIC): Promise<void> {\n    const normalizedIp = this.normalizeIp(ip);\n    \n    const localRep = this.localIpReputationsMap.get(normalizedIp);\n    if (localRep) {\n      if (localRep.isBlacklisted || localRep.score <= 0) {\n        throw new SecurityError('IP_RESTRICTED', `Your IP address ${normalizedIp} is restricted due to security violations.`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!this.tableExistence.ip_reputations) return;\n\n    try {\n      const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n      const { data: reputation, error: queryError } = await sb\n        .from('ip_reputations')\n        .select('*')\n        .eq('ip', normalizedIp)\n        .maybeSingle();\n\n      if (queryError) {\n        this.handleTableError('ip_reputations', queryError, isCritical, trafficClass);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      if (reputation) {\n        if (reputation.isBlacklisted) {\n          const ladder = [5, 15, 60, 360, 1440, 10080];\n          const durationIdx = Math.min((reputation.violationCount || 1) - 1, ladder.length - 1);\n          const cooldownMinutes = ladder[durationIdx];\n          const cooldownUntil = new Date(new Date(reputation.updatedAt).getTime() + cooldownMinutes * 60 * 1000);\n          \n          if (new Date() < cooldownUntil) {\n            throw new SecurityError('IP_RESTRICTED', `Your IP address is temporarily restricted due to repeated security violations. Cooldown ends at ${cooldownUntil.toISOString()}.`);\n          } else {\n            await sb.from('ip_reputations').update({ \n              isBlacklisted: false, \n              score: 20, \n              updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() \n            }).eq('ip', normalizedIp);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code === 'IP_RESTRICTED') throw e;\n      this.tableExistence.ip_reputations = false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  public async updateIpReputation(ip: string, penalty: number): Promise<void> {\n    const normalizedIp = this.normalizeIp(ip);\n    const existing = this.localIpReputationsMap.get(normalizedIp) || { score: 100, isBlacklisted: false };\n    const newScore = Math.max(0, existing.score - penalty);\n    this.localIpReputationsMap.set(normalizedIp, {\n      score: newScore,\n      isBlacklisted: penalty >= 100 || newScore === 0,\n    });\n\n    if (this.tableExistence.record_ip_penalty_atomic) {\n      try {\n        const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n        await sb.rpc('record_ip_penalty_atomic', {\n          p_ip: normalizedIp,\n          p_penalty: penalty\n        });\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.tableExistence.record_ip_penalty_atomic = false;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async checkEnforcements(identifier: string, policyName: string, isCritical: boolean = false, trafficClass: TrafficClass = TrafficClass.PUBLIC): Promise<void> {\n    const key = `${identifier}:${policyName}`;\n    const localEntry = this.localViolationsMap.get(key);\n    if (localEntry) {\n      if (localEntry.isPermanentlyBanned) {\n        throw new SecurityError('PERMANENT_BAN', 'Your access has been permanently revoked due to security violations.');\n      }\n      if (localEntry.suspendedUntil && new Date(localEntry.suspendedUntil) > new Date()) {\n        throw new SecurityError('SUSPENDED', `Access suspended until ${localEntry.suspendedUntil}.`, localEntry.suspendedUntil);\n      }\n    }\n\n    if (!this.tableExistence.security_violations) return;\n\n    try {\n      const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n      const { data: enforcement, error } = await sb\n        .from('security_violations')\n        .select('*')\n        .eq('identifier', identifier)\n        .eq('endpoint', policyName)\n        .maybeSingle();\n\n      if (error) {\n        this.handleTableError('security_violations', error, isCritical, trafficClass);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      if (enforcement) {\n        if (enforcement.isPermanentlyBanned) {\n          await this.syncUserStatus(identifier, 'banned', isCritical, trafficClass);\n          throw new SecurityError('PERMANENT_BAN', 'Your access has been permanently revoked due to repeated security violations.');\n        }\n\n        if (enforcement.suspendedUntil && new Date(enforcement.suspendedUntil) > new Date()) {\n          await this.syncUserStatus(identifier, 'suspended', isCritical, trafficClass);\n          throw new SecurityError('SUSPENDED', `Access suspended until ${enforcement.suspendedUntil}.`, enforcement.suspendedUntil);\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (e: any) {\n      if (e.code === 'PERMANENT_BAN' || e.code === 'SUSPENDED') throw e;\n      this.tableExistence.security_violations = false;\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async syncUserStatus(identifier: string, status: string, isCritical: boolean = false, trafficClass: TrafficClass = TrafficClass.PUBLIC): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.tableExistence.users) {\n      if (trafficClass !== TrafficClass.AGENT_AUTH) return;\n      return;\n    }\n\n    const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n    const { data: user, error } = await sb\n      .from('users')\n      .select('id, status')\n      .or(`id.eq.\"${identifier}\",agentId.eq.\"${identifier}\"`)\n      .maybeSingle();\n\n    if (error) {\n      if (this.handleTableError('users', error, isCritical, trafficClass)) return;\n      console.error('[SECURITY] User status sync failed (FAIL CLOSED):', error);\n      throw new SecurityError('INTERNAL_SECURITY_ERROR', 'Security state synchronization failed.');\n    }\n\n    if (user && user.status !== status) {\n      await sb.from('users').update({ status }).eq('id', user.id);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private handleTableError(componentName: string, error: any, isCritical: boolean = false, trafficClass: TrafficClass = TrafficClass.PUBLIC): boolean {\n    const errorCode = error?.code;\n    const errorMessage = error?.message?.toLowerCase() || '';\n    \n    const isMissingComponent = (\n      errorCode === '42P01' || \n      errorCode === 'PGRST202' || \n      errorCode === 'PGRST205' || \n      errorCode === 'PGRST204' ||\n      errorCode === 'PGRST200' ||\n      errorMessage.includes('does not exist') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('not found') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('missing') ||\n      errorMessage.includes('unknown rpc')\n    );\n\n    if (isMissingComponent) {\n      if (this.tableExistence[componentName]) {\n        console.warn(`[SECURITY] Security component ${componentName} missing or stale in DB (${errorCode || 'NO_CODE'}). Context: ${isCritical ? 'CRITICAL' : 'ADVISORY'}, Traffic: ${trafficClass}`);\n        this.tableExistence[componentName] = false;\n      }\n      \n      // FAIL OPEN for Human/Public traffic\n      if (trafficClass !== TrafficClass.AGENT_AUTH) {\n        return true;\n      }\n      \n      // FAIL CLOSED for Agent traffic\n      return false;\n    }\n    \n    return false;\n  }\n\n  private validateResourceLimits(req: Request, policy: SecurityPolicy): void {\n    if (!policy.resourceLimits) return;\n\n    const { maxBodySize, maxStringLength } = policy.resourceLimits;\n\n    if (maxBodySize && req.headers['content-length']) {\n      const size = parseInt(req.headers['content-length'] as string);\n      if (size > maxBodySize) {\n        throw new SecurityError('RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', `Payload size ${size} exceeds limit of ${maxBodySize}`);\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Deep check strings in body\n    if (maxStringLength && req.body) {\n      this.checkObjectStrings(req.body, maxStringLength);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private checkObjectStrings(obj: any, limit: number, depth: number = 0, seen: Set<any> = new Set()): void {\n    if (depth > 5) {\n      throw new SecurityError('RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', 'Payload depth exceeded safety limit (max depth: 5)');\n    }\n\n    if (obj === null || typeof obj !== 'object') return;\n    \n    if (seen.has(obj)) {\n      throw new SecurityError('RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', 'Circular reference detected in payload');\n    }\n    seen.add(obj);\n\n    for (const key in obj) {\n      const value = obj[key];\n      if (typeof value === 'string' && value.length > limit) {\n        throw new SecurityError('RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED', `Field '${key}' length exceeds limit of ${limit}`);\n      } else if (typeof value === 'object' && value !== null) {\n        this.checkObjectStrings(value, limit, depth + 1, seen);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async trackActivity(identifier: string, policyName: string): Promise<any> {\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyName];\n    if (!policy) return null;\n\n    const key = `${identifier}:${policyName}`;\n    if (!this.localViolationsMap.has(key)) {\n      this.localViolationsMap.set(key, {\n        identifier,\n        endpoint: policyName,\n        violationCount: 0,\n        suspensionCount: 0,\n        isPermanentlyBanned: false,\n        lastViolationAt: new Date().toISOString()\n      });\n    }\n\n    if (this.tableExistence.security_violations) {\n      try {\n        const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n        const now = new Date();\n        \n        const { data: violation, error } = await sb\n          .from('security_violations')\n          .select('*')\n          .eq('identifier', identifier)\n          .eq('endpoint', policyName)\n          .maybeSingle();\n\n        if (!error && !violation) {\n          await sb.from('security_violations').insert({\n            identifier,\n            endpoint: policyName,\n            severity: policy.severity,\n            violationCount: 0,\n            lastViolationAt: now.toISOString(),\n          });\n        }\n        if (error) {\n          this.handleTableError('security_violations', error);\n        }\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.tableExistence.security_violations = false;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  public async recordViolation(userIdOrAgentId: string, agentId: string, policyKey: string, severity: SecuritySeverity, reason: string, ip?: string): Promise<void> {\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyKey] || {\n      endpoint: policyKey,\n      severity,\n      warningThreshold: 1,\n      suspensionThreshold: 3,\n      suspensionDurationMs: 1 * 60 * 60 * 1000,\n      permanentBanThreshold: 5,\n      probationDurationMs: 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,\n    } as SecurityPolicy;\n\n    const identifier = userIdOrAgentId || agentId;\n    if (!identifier) return;\n\n    const effectiveSeverity = severity === SecuritySeverity.S3_CRITICAL ? SecuritySeverity.S3_CRITICAL : policy.severity;\n\n    if (this.tableExistence.record_violation_atomic) {\n      try {\n        const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n        \n        // Atomic RPC call for violation recording\n        const { data: violation, error } = await sb.rpc('record_violation_atomic', {\n          p_identifier: identifier,\n          p_endpoint: policyKey,\n          p_severity: effectiveSeverity,\n          p_ip: ip\n        });\n\n        if (!error && violation) {\n          await this.logEnforcementEvent({\n            identifier,\n            policyKey,\n            endpoint: policy.endpoint,\n            eventType: 'VIOLATION',\n            severity: effectiveSeverity,\n            reason,\n            ip\n          });\n\n          return this.processViolationEnforcement(violation, policyKey, effectiveSeverity);\n        }\n\n        if (error) {\n          this.handleTableError('record_violation_atomic', error);\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        if (e.code === 'PERMANENT_BAN' || e.code === 'SUSPENDED') throw e;\n        this.tableExistence.record_violation_atomic = false;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Local fallback if DB is not ready (Development / Test)\n    const key = `${identifier}:${policyKey}`;\n    const existing = this.localViolationsMap.get(key) || {\n      identifier,\n      endpoint: policyKey,\n      violationCount: 0,\n      suspensionCount: 0,\n      isPermanentlyBanned: false,\n      lastViolationAt: new Date().toISOString()\n    };\n    existing.violationCount += 1;\n    existing.lastViolationAt = new Date().toISOString();\n    this.localViolationsMap.set(key, existing);\n\n    if (existing.suspensionCount >= policy.permanentBanThreshold || existing.isPermanentlyBanned) {\n      existing.isPermanentlyBanned = true;\n      throw new SecurityError('PERMANENT_BAN', 'Your access has been permanently revoked due to security violations.');\n    }\n\n    if (existing.violationCount >= policy.suspensionThreshold || effectiveSeverity === SecuritySeverity.S3_CRITICAL) {\n      existing.suspensionCount += 1;\n      const suspendedUntil = new Date(Date.now() + (policy.suspensionDurationMs || 3600000)).toISOString();\n      existing.suspendedUntil = suspendedUntil;\n      throw new SecurityError('SUSPENDED', `Access suspended until ${suspendedUntil} due to security violations.`, suspendedUntil);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private async processViolationEnforcement(violation: any, policyKey: string, effectiveSeverity: SecuritySeverity): Promise<void> {\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyKey];\n    if (!policy) return;\n    \n    // Probation effect: Stricter thresholds (Priority 8)\n    const isProbation = violation.probationUntil && new Date(violation.probationUntil) > new Date();\n    const suspensionThreshold = isProbation ? Math.ceil(policy.suspensionThreshold / 2) : policy.suspensionThreshold;\n    const warningThreshold = isProbation ? Math.ceil(policy.warningThreshold / 2) : policy.warningThreshold;\n\n    // Critical escalation\n    if (effectiveSeverity === SecuritySeverity.S3_CRITICAL) {\n      await this.enforceSuspension(violation, policyKey, true);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Check thresholds for escalation\n    if (violation.violationCount >= suspensionThreshold) {\n      await this.enforceSuspension(violation, policyKey);\n    } else if (violation.violationCount >= warningThreshold) {\n      await this.enforceWarning(violation, policyKey);\n    }\n  }\n\n\n\n  public async getEnforcementHistory(identifier: string, endpoint: string): Promise<any> {\n    if (this.tableExistence.security_violations) {\n      try {\n        const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n        const { data, error } = await sb\n          .from('security_violations')\n          .select('*')\n          .eq('identifier', identifier)\n          .eq('endpoint', endpoint)\n          .maybeSingle();\n\n        if (!error && data) return data;\n        if (error) this.handleTableError('security_violations', error);\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.tableExistence.security_violations = false;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const key = `${identifier}:${endpoint}`;\n    if (this.localViolationsMap.has(key)) {\n      return this.localViolationsMap.get(key);\n    }\n\n    for (const [mapKey, val] of this.localViolationsMap.entries()) {\n      if (val.endpoint === endpoint) {\n        return val;\n      }\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  public async getIpReputation(ip: string): Promise<any> {\n    const normalizedIp = this.normalizeIp(ip);\n    if (this.tableExistence.ip_reputations) {\n      try {\n        const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n        const { data, error } = await sb\n          .from('ip_reputations')\n          .select('*')\n          .eq('ip', normalizedIp)\n          .maybeSingle();\n\n        if (!error && data) return data;\n        if (error) this.handleTableError('ip_reputations', error);\n      } catch (e) {\n        this.tableExistence.ip_reputations = false;\n      }\n    }\n    return this.localIpReputationsMap.get(normalizedIp) || { score: 100, isBlacklisted: false };\n  }\n\n  public async recordCriticalViolation(identifier: string, policyKey: string, reason: string, ip?: string): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.tableExistence.record_critical_violation_atomic) {\n      try {\n        const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n        \n        // Atomic critical violation RPC\n        const { data: violation, error } = await sb.rpc('record_critical_violation_atomic', {\n          p_identifier: identifier,\n          p_endpoint: policyKey,\n          p_reason: reason,\n          p_ip: ip\n        });\n\n        if (!error && violation) {\n          await this.logEnforcementEvent({\n            identifier,\n            policyKey,\n            endpoint: GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyKey]?.endpoint || policyKey,\n            eventType: 'BAN',\n            severity: SecuritySeverity.S3_CRITICAL,\n            reason,\n            ip\n          });\n\n          return this.enforcePermanentBan(violation, policyKey);\n        }\n\n        if (error) {\n          this.handleTableError('record_critical_violation_atomic', error);\n        }\n      } catch (e: any) {\n        if (e.code === 'PERMANENT_BAN') throw e;\n        this.tableExistence.record_critical_violation_atomic = false;\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Local fallback if DB is not ready (Development / Test)\n    const key = `${identifier}:${policyKey}`;\n    const existing = this.localViolationsMap.get(key) || {\n      identifier,\n      endpoint: policyKey,\n      violationCount: 1,\n      suspensionCount: 1,\n      isPermanentlyBanned: true,\n      lastViolationAt: new Date().toISOString()\n    };\n    existing.isPermanentlyBanned = true;\n    this.localViolationsMap.set(key, existing);\n    throw new SecurityError('PERMANENT_BAN', 'Your access has been permanently revoked due to security violations.');\n  }\n\n  private async enforceWarning(violation: any, policyKey: string): Promise<void> {\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyKey];\n    await this.logEnforcementEvent({\n      identifier: violation.identifier,\n      policyKey,\n      endpoint: policy.endpoint,\n      eventType: 'WARNING',\n      severity: policy.severity,\n      reason: `Violation thresholdReached. Current count: ${violation.violationCount}`,\n      violationCount: violation.violationCount,\n      previousStatus: 'ACTIVE',\n      newStatus: 'WARNED',\n      ip: violation.ip\n    });\n  }\n\n  private async enforceSuspension(violation: any, policyKey: string, immediate: boolean = false): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.tableExistence.security_violations) return;\n\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyKey];\n    const newSuspensionCount = (violation.suspensionCount || 0) + 1;\n    \n    if (newSuspensionCount >= policy.permanentBanThreshold) {\n      await this.enforcePermanentBan(violation, policyKey);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Suspension Ladder: 1h -> 6h -> 24h -> 3d -> 7d -> 30d (Max)\n    const ladderMs = [\n      1 * 60 * 60 * 1000,        // 1 hour\n      6 * 60 * 60 * 1000,        // 6 hours\n      24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,       // 24 hours\n      3 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,   // 3 days\n      7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,   // 7 days\n      30 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,  // 30 days\n    ];\n    \n    const actualDuration = ladderMs[Math.min(newSuspensionCount - 1, ladderMs.length - 1)];\n    const suspendedUntil = new Date(Date.now() + actualDuration);\n    \n    // Probation Ladder\n    const probationDaysLadder = [1, 3, 7, 14, 30, 90];\n    const probationDays = probationDaysLadder[Math.min(newSuspensionCount - 1, probationDaysLadder.length - 1)];\n    const probationDurationMs = probationDays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\n    const probationUntil = new Date(suspendedUntil.getTime() + probationDurationMs);\n\n    const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n    const { error: updateError } = await sb\n      .from('security_violations')\n      .update({\n        suspensionCount: newSuspensionCount,\n        suspendedUntil: suspendedUntil.toISOString(),\n        probationUntil: probationUntil.toISOString(),\n        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()\n      })\n      .eq('id', violation.id);\n\n    if (updateError) {\n      if (this.handleTableError('security_violations', updateError)) return;\n      console.error('[SECURITY] Failed to enforce suspension (FAIL CLOSED):', updateError);\n      throw new SecurityError('INTERNAL_SECURITY_ERROR', 'Security enforcement failed.');\n    }\n\n    await this.syncUserStatus(violation.identifier, 'suspended');\n\n    await this.logEnforcementEvent({\n      identifier: violation.identifier,\n      policyKey,\n      endpoint: policy.endpoint,\n      eventType: 'SUSPENSION',\n      severity: policy.severity,\n      reason: `Suspension enforced. #${newSuspensionCount}. Probation: ${probationDays}d.`,\n      ip: violation.ip,\n      violationCount: violation.violationCount,\n      suspensionCount: newSuspensionCount,\n      previousStatus: 'ACTIVE',\n      newStatus: 'SUSPENDED'\n    });\n\n    throw new SecurityError('SUSPENDED', `Access suspended until ${suspendedUntil.toISOString()} due to security violations.`, suspendedUntil.toISOString());\n  }\n\n  private async enforcePermanentBan(violation: any, policyKey: string): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.tableExistence.security_violations) return;\n\n    const policy = GLOBAL_SECURITY_POLICIES[policyKey];\n    \n    const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n    const { error: updateError } = await sb\n      .from('security_violations')\n      .update({\n        isPermanentlyBanned: true,\n        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString()\n      })\n      .eq('id', violation.id);\n\n    if (updateError) {\n      if (this.handleTableError('security_violations', updateError)) return;\n      console.error('[SECURITY] Failed to enforce permanent ban (FAIL CLOSED):', updateError);\n      throw new SecurityError('INTERNAL_SECURITY_ERROR', 'Security enforcement failed.');\n    }\n\n    await this.syncUserStatus(violation.identifier, 'banned');\n\n    await this.logEnforcementEvent({\n      identifier: violation.identifier,\n      policyKey,\n      endpoint: policy.endpoint,\n      eventType: 'BAN',\n      severity: SecuritySeverity.S3_CRITICAL,\n      reason: `Permanent ban enforced.`,\n      violationCount: violation.violationCount,\n      suspensionCount: violation.suspensionCount + 1,\n      previousStatus: 'SUSPENDED',\n      newStatus: 'BANNED',\n      ip: violation.ip\n    });\n\n    throw new SecurityError('PERMANENT_BAN', 'Your access has been permanently revoked due to security violations.');\n  }\n\n  private async logEnforcementEvent(event: any): Promise<void> {\n    if (!this.tableExistence.security_enforcement_events) return;\n    \n    const sb = getSupabaseClient();\n    const redactedEvent = redactSensitiveData(event);\n\n    let userId = null;\n    let agentId = null;\n\n    if (event.identifier) {\n      const { data: user, error } = await sb\n        .from('users')\n        .select('id, agentId')\n        .or(`id.eq.\"${event.identifier}\",agentId.eq.\"${event.identifier}\"`)\n        .maybeSingle();\n      \n      if (error) {\n        console.error('[SECURITY] Identity lookup failed for event log:', error);\n      } else if (user) {\n        userId = user.id;\n        agentId = user.agentId;\n      }\n    }\n\n    const { error: insertError } = await sb.from('security_enforcement_events').insert({\n      userId,\n      agentId,\n      identifier: event.identifier,\n      policyKey: event.policyKey,\n      endpoint: event.endpoint,\n      eventType: event.eventType,\n      severity: event.severity,\n      reason: redactedEvent.reason,\n      ip: event.ip,\n      evidence: redactSensitiveData(event.evidence || redactedEvent),\n      violationCount: event.violationCount,\n      suspensionCount: event.suspensionCount,\n      previousStatus: event.previousStatus,\n      newStatus: event.newStatus,\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString()\n    });\n\n    if (insertError) {\n      console.error('[SECURITY] Failed to insert enforcement event:', insertError);\n    }\n\n    await logAccountAudit({\n      agentId: agentId || event.identifier,\n      eventType: `SECURITY_ENFORCEMENT_${event.eventType}`,\n      actionSource: 'SYSTEM',\n      details: redactedEvent\n    });\n  }\n\n  public async trackBehavioralSignal(userOrIdentifier: string, signalType: string, details: any): Promise<void> {\n    const signalsWeight: Record<string, number> = {\n 224.0.0.0/4 (Multicast)\n    if (o1 >= 224 && o1 <= 239) return true;\n    // 240.0.0.0/4 (Reserved)\n    if (o1 >= 240) return true;\n    // 255.255.255.255 (Broadcast)\n    if (o1 === 255 && o2 === 255 && o3 === 255 && o4 === 255) return true;\n\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // IPv6 Evaluation\n  if (cleanIp === '::' || cleanIp === '::1') return true;\n  if (cleanIp.startsWith('fc') || cleanIp.startsWith('fd')) return true; // Unique local address (fc00::/7)\n  if (cleanIp.startsWith('fe8') || cleanIp.startsWith('fe9') || cleanIp.startsWith('fea') || cleanIp.startsWith('feb')) return true; // Link-local (fe80::/10)\n  if (cleanIp.startsWith('ff')) return true; // Multicast (ff00::/8)\n  if (cleanIp.startsWith('2001:db8:')) return true; // Documentation\n  if (cleanIp.startsWith('100::')) return true; // Discard-only\n\n  return false;\n}\n\n/**\n * Checks whether a hostname belongs to internal or cloud-metadata domain names\n */\nexport function isHostnameRestricted(hostname: string): boolean {\n  if (!hostname || typeof hostname !== 'string') return true;\n  const h = hostname.trim().toLowerCase();\n  if (\n    h === 'localhost' ||\n    h === '0.0.0.0' ||\n    h.endsWith('.localhost') ||\n    h.endsWith('.local') ||\n    h.endsWith('.internal') ||\n    h.endsWith('.localdomain') ||\n    h === 'metadata.google.internal' ||\n    h === 'instance-data'\n  ) {\n    return true;\n  }\n  return false;\n}\n\n/**\n * Creates an SSRF-safe HTTP/HTTPS Agent that enforces destination IP restrictions\n * at the actual connection socket layer. This eliminates DNS rebinding attacks.\n */\nexport function createSsrfSafeAgent(isHttps: boolean) {\n  const safeLookup = (\n    hostname: string,\n    options: any,\n    callback: (err: NodeJS.ErrnoException | null, address: any, family?: number) => void\n  ) => {\n    if (isHostnameRestricted(hostname)) {\n      const err: any = new Error(`SSRF blocked: Domain '${hostname}' is restricted.`);\n      err.code = 'ENOTFOUND';\n      return callback(err, '', 4);\n    }\n\n    if (isIpRestricted(hostname)) {\n      const err: any = new Error(`SSRF blocked: Address '${hostname}' is in a restricted subnet.`);\n      err.code = 'ENOTFOUND';\n      return callback(err, '', 4);\n    }\n\n    dns.lookup(hostname, { all: true }, (err, addresses) => {\n      if (err) return callback(err, '', 4);\n      if (!addresses || addresses.length === 0) {\n        const notFoundErr: any = new Error(`DNS resolution failed for '${hostname}'`);\n        notFoundErr.code = 'ENOTFOUND';\n        return callback(notFoundErr, '', 4);\n      }\n\n      for (const rec of addresses) {\n        if (isIpRestricted(rec.address)) {\n          const ssrfErr: any = new Error(\n            `SSRF blocked at connection layer: Hostname '${hostname}' resolved to restricted IP '${rec.address}'.`\n          );\n          ssrfErr.code = 'ECONNREFUSED';\n          return callback(ssrfErr, '', 4);\n        }\n      }\n\n      const first = addresses[0];\n      if (options && options.all) {\n        return callback(null, addresses, first.family);\n      }\n      return callback(null, first.address, first.family);\n    });\n  };\n\n  const agentOptions = {\n    lookup: safeLookup,\n    keepAlive: false,\n    timeout: 15000\n  };\n\n  return isHttps ? new https.Agent(agentOptions) : new http.Agent(agentOptions);\n}\n\n/**\n * SSRF-safe fetch implementation for official MCP SDK transports.\n * Enforces destination IP restrictions and connection-layer SSRF defense via createSsrfSafeAgent().\n */\nexport async function ssrfSafeFetch(input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit): Promise<Response> {\n  const urlStr = typeof input === 'string' ? input : input instanceof URL ? input.toString() : input.url;\n\n  const ssrf = await validateEndpointUrl(urlStr);\n  if (!ssrf.valid) {\n    throw new Error(`SSRF blocked at transport fetch: ${ssrf.error}`);\n  }\n\n  // Create an Undici dispatcher that enforces our IP restrictions via a custom lookup\n  const dispatcher = new UndiciAgent({\n    connect: {\n      lookup: safeLookup\n    }\n  });\n\n  return fetch(urlStr, {\n    ...init,\n    // @ts-ignore - undici dispatcher fits the fetch signature\n    dispatcher\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Validates endpoint URL against SSRF, resolving DNS hostnames and enforcing IP restrictions.\n * Enforces HTTPS in production and rejects plaintext HTTP when credentials are transmitted.\n * Mock endpoints are strictly rejected in production.\n */\nexport async function validateEndpointUrl(\n  endpointUrl: string,\n  authType: string = 'none',\n  hasCredential: boolean = false\n): Promise<{ valid: boolean; error?: string }> {\n  if (!endpointUrl || typeof endpointUrl !== 'string') {\n    return { valid: false, error: 'Endpoint URL is required' };\n  }\n\n  const trimmed = endpointUrl.trim();\n\n  // Mock endpoints are strictly restricted to isolated automated test suites\n  if (trimmed.startsWith('mock://') || trimmed.includes('mock-mcp.internal')) {\n    if (!isStrictTestEnvironment() || process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {\n      return {\n        valid: false,\n        error: 'Restricted target: Mock endpoints are strictly prohibited outside automated test environments.'\n      };\n    }\n    return { valid: true };\n  }\n\n  let parsed: URL;\n  try {\n    parsed = new URL(trimmed);\n  } catch {\n    return { valid: false, error: 'Malformed endpoint URL. Must include protocol (e.g. https://...)' };\n  }\n\n  if (parsed.protocol !== 'http:' && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') {\n    return { valid: false, error: 'Unsupported protocol. Only http: and https: are allowed.' };\n  }\n\n  // 1. Require HTTPS for remote MCP endpoints in production unless an explicitly approved secure transport design exists\n  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && parsed.protocol !== 'https:') {\n    return {\n      valid: false,\n      error: 'Insecure protocol: HTTPS is strictly required for remote MCP endpoints in production.'\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 2. Prohibit sending credentials or bearer/API keys over plaintext HTTP in any environment\n  if (parsed.protocol === 'http:' && (authType !== 'none' || hasCredential)) {\n    return {\n      valid: false,\n      error: 'Insecure transport: Plaintext HTTP is prohibited when sending credentials, bearer tokens, or API keys. HTTPS is required.'\n    };\n  }\n\n  // Prohibit embedded credentials in URL\n  if (parsed.username || parsed.password) {\n    return { valid: false, error: 'Embedded credentials in endpoint URL are prohibited.' };\n  }\n\n  // Check port restrictions (block internal service ports)\n  if (parsed.port) {\n    const portNum = parseInt(parsed.port, 10);\n    const blockedPorts = [21, 22, 23, 25, 53, 110, 143, 445, 1433, 3306, 5432, 6379, 11211, 27017, 28017];\n    if (blockedPorts.includes(portNum)) {\n      return { valid: false, error: `Restricted target: Port ${portNum} is blocked for security.` };\n    }\n  }\n\n  const hostname = parsed.hostname.toLowerCase();\n\n  // Block loopback and known cloud internal hostnames\n  if (isHostnameRestricted(hostname)) {\n    return { valid: false, error: 'Restricted target: Local and internal domain names are blocked.' };\n  }\n\n  // If hostname is directly an IP literal\n  if (isIpRestricted(hostname)) {\n    return { valid: false, error: 'Restricted target: Private, loopback, or cloud metadata IP addresses are blocked.' };\n  }\n\n  // Pre-validate DNS resolution to give helpful user-facing errors\n  try {\n    const lookup = await dns.promises.lookup(hostname, { all: true });\n    if (!lookup || lookup.length === 0) {\n      return { valid: false, error: `Unable to resolve server domain '${hostname}'.` };\n    }\n    for (const record of lookup) {\n      if (isIpRestricted(record.address)) {\n        return {\n          valid: false,\n          error: `Restricted target: Resolved IP address '${record.address}' belongs to a private, loopback, or metadata subnet.`\n        };\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (err: any) {\n    return { valid: false, error: `DNS resolution failed for '${hostname}': ${err.message}` };\n  }\n\n  return { valid: true };\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 3. FLEET OWNERSHIP VERIFICATION\n// ============================================================================\n\n/**\n * Enforces Master/Slave boundary: verifies target agent is an authentic member of operator's fleet\n */\nexport async function verifyAgentInOperatorFleet(operatorUserId: string, targetAgentId: string): Promise<boolean> {\n  if (!operatorUserId || !targetAgentId) return false;\n  // An operator can always assign tools to their primary account\n  if (targetAgentId === operatorUserId) return true;\n\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  try {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('users')\n      .select('id, agentId, master_id')\n      .or(`id.eq.${targetAgentId},agentId.eq.${targetAgentId}`)\n      .maybeSingle();\n\n    if (!error && data) {\n      return data.id === operatorUserId || data.master_id === operatorUserId;\n    }\n  } catch {}\n\n  // In test / offline mode, check naming convention or local fleet registry\n  if (isStrictTestEnvironment()) {\n    if (targetAgentId.includes('slave') || targetAgentId === operatorUserId) {\n      return true;\n    }\n  }\n\n  return false;\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 4. JSON SCHEMA TOOL ARGUMENT VALIDATION (AJV & JSON SCHEMA DIALECT)\n// ============================================================================\n\n/**\n * Validates tool invocation arguments against the discovered JSON schema using Ajv.\n * Strictly verifies types, constraints, required parameters, and rejects malformed schemas and invalid arguments.\n */\nexport function validateToolArguments(\n  schema: Record<string, any>,\n  args: Record<string, any>\n): { valid: boolean; error?: string } {\n  if (!schema || typeof schema !== 'object' || Array.isArray(schema)) {\n    return { valid: false, error: 'Malformed tool schema: schema must be an object' };\n  }\n\n  if (args === null || typeof args !== 'object' || Array.isArray(args)) {\n    return { valid: false, error: 'Tool arguments must be a JSON object' };\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const validate = ajv.compile(schema);\n    const valid = validate(args);\n    if (!valid) {\n      const errorText = ajv.errorsText(validate.errors, { separator: '; ' });\n      return { valid: false, error: errorText || 'Arguments failed schema validation' };\n    }\n    return { valid: true };\n  } catch (schemaErr: any) {\n    return { valid: false, error: `Malformed tool schema: ${schemaErr?.message || 'Invalid JSON Schema'}` };\n  }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 5. MCP CLIENT & PROTOCOL COMMUNICATION (Streamable HTTP & SSE)\n// ============================================================================\n\n/**\n * Sanitizes server info object to ensure sensitive session tokens, credentials, or internal IDs\n * are never leaked to client responses.\n */\nexport function sanitizeServerInfo(serverInfo: Record<string, any> | undefined): Record<string, any> {\n  if (!serverInfo || typeof serverInfo !== 'object') return {};\n  const copy: Record<string, any> = { ...serverInfo };\n  delete copy.sessionId;\n  delete copy.session_id;\n  delete copy.token;\n  delete copy.secret;\n  delete copy.credential;\n  delete copy.credentials;\n  delete copy.mcpSessionId;\n  delete copy.mcp_session_id;\n  return copy;\n}\n\nfunction buildAuthHeaders(\n  authType: 'none' | 'bearer' | 'api-key' | 'custom-header',\n  credential?: string,\n  headerName?: string\n): Record<string, string> {\n  const headers: Record<string, string> = {\n    'Content-Type': 'application/json',\n    'Accept': 'application/json, text/event-stream'\n  };\n\n  if (!credential || authType === 'none') {\n    return headers;\n  }\n\n  if (authType === 'bearer') {\n (authType === 'custom-header' && headerName?.trim()) {\n    headers[headerName.trim()] = credential;\n  }\n\n  return headers;\n}\n\n/**\n * Parses raw stream response that may be JSON or Server-Sent Events (SSE).\n */\nexport function parseMcpResponseBody(rawBody: any, contentType?: string): any {\n  if (!rawBody) return null;\n  if (typeof rawBody === 'object') return rawBody;\n\n  const text = String(rawBody).trim();\n\n  // If text/event-stream or SSE-formatted lines\n  if ((contentType && contentType.includes('text/event-stream')) || text.startsWith('event:') || text.startsWith('data:')) Re-verify SSRF destination and HTTPS protocol\n  const ssrf = await validateEndpointUrl(server.endpoint, server.auth_type, Boolean(server.auth_credential_encrypted));\n  if (!ssrf.valid) {\n    return { success: false, error: `Outbound security check rejected destination: ${ssrf.error}` };\n  }\n\n  // 5. Attempt execution using official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk where compatible\n  let client: Client | null = null;\n  try {\n    const url = new URL(server.endpoint);\n    const sdkTransport = server.transport === 'http-sse'\n      ? new SSEClientTransport(url, {\n          requestInit: { headers },\n          fetch: ssrfSafeFetch,\n        })\n      : new StreamableHTTPClientTransport(url, {\n          requestInit: { headers },\n          sessionId: storedSessionId,\n          fetch: ssrfSafeFetch,\n        });\n\n    client = new Client(\n      { name: 'aamarva-floor', version: '1.0.0' },\n      { capabilities: {} }\n    );\n\n    await client.connect(sdkTransport);\n    const toolRes = await client.callTool({\n      name: tool.name,\n      arguments: toolArgs || {},\n    });\n\n    const newSessionId = (sdkTransport as any).sessionId;\n    if (newSessionId && newSessionId !== storedSessionId) {\n      serverSessionStore.set(server.id, newSessionId);\n      try {\n        const enc = encryptMcpCredential(newSessionId);\n        const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n        await supabase.from('mcp_servers').update({ session_id_encrypted: enc }).eq('id', server.id);\n      } catch (err) {\n        if (shouldFailOnDbError()) throw err;\n      }\n    }\n\n    return {\n      success: true,\n      result: toolRes\n    };\n  } catch (sdkErr: any) {\n    // No automatic duplicate tool execution fallback after an MCP SDK invocation fails.\n    // Report execution failure directly without a second retry attempt.\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: `Execution error: ${sdkErr?.message || 'Remote MCP server failed to execute tool'}`\n    };\n  } finally {\n    if (client) {\n      await client.close().catch(() => {});\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// ============================================================================\n// 6. MCP SERVER INVENTORY & LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT\n// ============================================================================\n\n/**\n * List all configured MCP servers belonging to the user\n */\nexport async function listUserMcpServers(userId: string): Promise<McpServerRecord[]> {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  let servers: McpServerRecord[] = [];\n\n  try {\n    const { s.owner_id === userId);\n    }\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (shouldFailOnDbError()) throw err;\n    servers = Array.from(inMemoryServers.values()).filter((s) => s.owner_id === userId);\n  }\n\n  // Augment with tool counts & strictly redact credentials and session tokens\n  const sanitized = await Promise.all(\n    servers.map(async (server) => {\n      const tools = await listToolsForServer(userId, server.id);\n      const assignments = await listAssignmentsForServer(server.id);\n      const uniqueAssigned = new Set(assignments.map((a) => a.agent_id));\n\n      const { auth_credential_encrypted, session_id_encrypted, server_info, ...rest } = server;\n      return {\n        ...rest,\n        has_credential: Boolean(auth_credential_encrypted && auth_credential_encrypted.length > 0),\n        server_info: sanitizeServerInfo(server_info),\n        tools_count: tools.length,\n        assigned_agents_count: uniqueAssigned.size\n      };\n    })\n  );\n\n  return sanitized;\n}\n\n/**\n * Retrieve a specific MCP server with ownership verification\n */\nexport async function getMcpServer(userId: string, serverId: string): Promise<McpServerRecord | null> {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  let server: McpServerRecord | null = null;\n\n  try {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('mcp_servers')\n      .select('*')\n      .eq('id', serverId)\n      .eq('owner_id', userId)\n      .maybeSingle();\n\n    if (!error && data) {\n      server = data;\n    } else if (error && null;\n\n  const tools = await listToolsForServer(userId, server.id);\n  const assignments = await listAssignmentsForServer(server.id);\n  const uniqueAssigned = new Set(assignments.map((a) => identifiers\n    tools_count: tools.length,\n    assigned_agents_count: uniqueAssigned.size\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Adds an MCP server, validates connection, performs live handshake, encrypts credentials at rest, and discovers tools\n */\nexport async function addMcpServerWithDiscovery(\n  userId: string,\n  params: {\n    name: string;\n    endpoint: string;\n    description?: string;\n    transport?: 'http-streamable' | 'http-sse';\n    auth_type?: 'none' | 'bearer' | 'api-key' | 'custom-header';\n    auth_header_name?: string;\n    auth_credential?: string;\n  }\n): Promise<{ server: McpServerRecord; tools: McpToolRecord[]; error?: string }> {\n  const name = params.name.trim();\n  const endpoint = params.endpoint.trim();\n  const transport = params.transport || 'http-streamable';\n  const authType = params.auth_type || 'none';\n  const headerName = params.auth_header_name?.trim();\n  const credential = params.auth_credential?.trim();\n\n  if (transport !== 'http-streamable' && transport !== 'http-sse') {\n    throw new Error(`Unsupported transport '${transport}'. Only 'http-streamable' and 'http-sse' are supported.`);\n  }\n\n  // 1. SSRF Boundary Enforcement & HTTPS verification\n  const ssrf = await validateEndpointUrl(endpoint, authType, Boolean(credential));\n  if (!ssrf.valid) {\n    throw new Error(ssrf.error || 'Invalid or forbidden endpoint URL.');\n  }\n\n  // 2. Perform live protocol handshake and discovery\n  const discovery = await testMcpConnectionAndDiscover(endpoint, authType, credential, headerName, transport);\n\n  const serverId = crypto.randomUUID();\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n\n  // Store session identifier privately on backend and encrypt for serverless persistence\n  let encryptedSessionId: string | undefined = undefined;\n  if (discovery.sessionId) {\n    serverSessionStore.set(serverId, discovery.sessionId);\n    encryptedSessionId = encryptMcpCredential(discovery.sessionId);\n  }\n\n  // 3. Encrypt credential at rest using AES-256-GCM\n  const encryptedCredential = credential ? encryptMcpCredential(credential) : undefined;\n\n  const newServerRecord: McpServerRecord = {\n    id: serverId,\n    owner_id: userId,\n    name,\n    description: params.description?.trim() || '',\n    transport,\n    endpoint,\n    auth_type: authType,\n    auth_header_name: headerName,\n    auth_credential_encrypted: encryptedCredential,\n    session_id_encrypted: encryptedSessionId,\n    status: discovery.status,\n    last_checked: now,\n    last_error: discovery.error,\n    server_info: sanitizeServerInfo(discovery.serverInfo),\n    created_at: now,\n    updated_at: now\n  };\n\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  let savedServer = newServerRecord;\n\n  try {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('mcp_servers')\n      .insert(newServerRecord)\n      .select()\n      .single();\n\n    if (error && shouldFailOnDbError()) {\n      throw new Error(`Database persistence failed: ${error.message}`);\n    }\n    if (!error && data) {\n      savedServer = data;\n    }\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (shouldFailOnDbError()) throw err;\n  }\n  inMemoryServers.set(serverId, savedServer);\n\n  // 4. Save discovered tools\n  const savedTools: McpToolRecord[] = [];\n  for (const t of discovery.tools) {\n    const toolId = crypto.randomUUID();\n    const toolRecord: McpToolRecord = {\n      id: toolId,\n      server_id: serverId,\n      owner_id: userId,\n      name: t.name,\n      description: t.description || '',\n      input_schema: t.inputSchema || { type: 'object' },\n      is_enabled: true,\n      created_at: now,\n      updated_at: now\n    };\n\n    let savedTool = toolRecord;\n    try {\n      const { data, error } = await supabase\n        .from('mcp_tools')\n        .insert(toolRecord)\n        .select()\n        .single();\n\n      if (error && shouldFailOnDbError()) {\n        throw new Error(`Database error saving tool '${t.name}': ${error.message}`);\n      }\n      if (!error && data) {\n        savedTool = data;\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      if (shouldFailOnDbError()) throw err;\n    }\n    inMemoryTools.set(savedTool.id, savedTool);\n    savedTools.push(savedTool);\n  }\n\n  // Redact credentials and session IDs before returning to client\n  const sanitized = {\n    ...savedServer,\n    has_credential: Boolean(credential),\n    auth_credential_encrypted: undefined,\n    session_id_encrypted: undefined,\n    server_info: sanitizeServerInfo(savedServer.server_info),\n    tools_count: savedTools.length,\n    assigned_agents_count: 0\n  };\n\n  return {\n    server: sanitized,\n    tools: savedTools,\n    error: discovery.error\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Re-validates connection and fully synchronizes tools (updates schemas, adds new tools, removes deleted tools).\n * Propagates production database errors instead of silently converting them into a missing-server result.\n */\nexport async function revalidateAndSyncMcpServer(\n  userId: string,\n  serverId: string\n): Promise<{ server: McpServerRecord; tools: McpToolRecord[]; error?: string }> {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  let server: McpServerRecord | null = null;\n\n  try {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('mcp_servers')\n      .select('*')\n      .eq('id', serverId)\n      .eq('owner_id', userId)\n      .maybeSingle();\n\n    if (error && shouldFailOnDbError()) {\n      throw new Error(`Database error retrieving MCP server: ${error.message}`);\n    }\n    server = data;\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (shouldFailOnDbError()) throw err;\n  }\n\n  if (!server) {\n    server = inMemoryServers.get(serverId) || null;\n    if (server && server.owner_id !== userId) server = null;\n  }\n\n  if (!server) {\n    throw new Error('MCP server not found or unauthorized.');\n  }\n\n  const discovery = await testMcpConnectionAndDiscover(\n    server.endpoint,\n    server.auth_type,\n    server.auth_credential_encrypted,\n    server.auth_header_name,\n    server.transport\n  );\n\n  const now = new Date().toISOString();\n  const updatedStatus = discovery.status;\n  const updatedError = discovery.error || null;\n  const sanitizedServerInfo = sanitizeServerInfo(discovery.serverInfo);\n\n  let updatedEncryptedSessionId = server.session_id_encrypted;\n  if (discovery.sessionId) {\n    serverSessionStore.set(serverId, discovery.sessionId);\n    updatedEncryptedSessionId = encryptMcpCredential(discovery.sessionId);\n  }\n\n  try {\n    const { error } = await supabase\n      .from('mcp_servers')\n      .update({\n        status: updatedStatus,\n        last_checked: now,\n        last_error: updatedError,\n        server_info: sanitizedServerInfo,\n        session_id_encrypted: updatedEncryptedSessionId,\n        updated_at: now\n      })\n      .eq('id', serverId);\n\n    if (error && shouldFailOnDbError()) {\n      throw new Error(`Database error updating server status: ${error.message}`);\n    }\n  } catch (err) {\n    if (shouldFailOnDbError()) throw err;\n  }\n\n  server.status = updatedStatus;\n  server.last_checked = now;\n  server.last_error = updatedError || undefined;\n  server.server_info = sanitizedServerInfo;\n  server.session_id_encrypted = updatedEncryptedSessionId;\n  server.updated_at = now;\n  inMemoryServers.set(serverId, server);\n\n  // If connection was successful, synchronize tools\n  if (discovery.success) {\n    const existingTools = await listToolsForServer(userId, serverId);\n    const remoteToolMap = new Map<string, { name: string; description?: string; inputSchema?: Record<string, any> }>();\n    for (const rt of discovery.tools) {\n      remoteToolMap.set(rt.name, rt);\n    }\n\n    // 1. Update existing tools or remove tools no longer exposed by server\n    for (const existing of existingTools) {\n      const matchingRemote = remoteToolMap.get(existing.name);\n      if (matchingRemote) {\n        try {\n          await supabase\n            .from('mcp_tools')\n            .update({\n              description: matchingRemote.description || '',\n              input_schema: matchingRemote.inputSchema || { type: 'object' },\n              updated_at: now\n            })\n            .eq('id', existing.id);\n        } catch {}\n        const updatedRec = {\n          ...existing,\n          description: matchingRemote.description || '',\n          input_schema: matchingRemote.inputSchema || { type: 'object' },\n          updated_at: now\n        };\n        inMemoryTools.set(existing.id, updatedRec);\n      } else {\n        // Tool was removed on remote: prune assignments and delete tool\n        try {\n          await supabase.from('mcp_tool_assignments').delete().eq('tool_id', existing.id);\n          await supabase.from('mcp_tools').delete().eq('id', existing.id);\n        } catch {}\n        inMemoryTools.delete(existing.id);\n        for (const [aId, a] of inMemoryAssignments.entries()) {\n          if (a.tool_id === existing.id) inMemoryAssignments.delete(aId);\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Add newly discovered tools (start unassigned / zero-trust)\n    for (const [name, rt] of remoteToolMap.entries()) {\n      const alreadyExists = existingTools.some((et) => et.name === name);\n      if (!alreadyExists) {\n        const toolId = crypto.randomUUID();\n        const toolRec: McpToolRecord = {\n          id: toolId,\n          server_id: serverId,\n          owner_id: userId,\n          name: rt.name,\n          description: rt.description || '',\n          input_schema: rt.inputSchema || { type: 'object' },\n          is_enabled: true,\n          created_at: now,\n          updated_at: now\n        };\n        try {\n          await supabase.from('mcp_tools').insert(toolRec);\n        } catch {}\n        inMemoryTools.set(toolId, toolRec);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  const currentTools = await listToolsForServer(userId, serverId);\n  const assignments = await listAssignmentsForServer(serverId);\n  const uniqueAssigned = new Set(assignments.map((a) => a.agent_id));\n\n  return {\n    server: {\n      ...server,\n      has_credential: Boolean(server.auth_credential_encrypted),\n      auth_credential_encrypted: undefined,\n      session_id_encrypted: undefined,\n      server_info: sanitizeServerInfo(server.server_info),\n      tools_count: currentTools.length,\n      assigned_agents_count: uniqueAssigned.size\n    },\n    tools: currentTools,\n    error: discovery.error\n  };\n}\n\n/**\n * Removes an MCP server and cascades deletion of its tools & assignments\n */\nexport async function removeMcpServer(userId: string, serverId: string): Promise<boolean> {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  try {\n    const { error: assnErr } = await supabase.from('mcp_tool_assignments').delete().eq('server_id', serverId);\n    if (assnErr && shouldFailOnDbError()) throw assnErr;\n\n    const { error: toolsErr } = await supabase.from('mcp_tools').delete().eq('server_id', serverId).eq('owner_id', userId);\n    if (toolsErr && shouldFailOnDbError()) throw toolsErr;\n\n    const { error: srvErr } = await supabase.from('mcp_servers').delete().eq('id', serverId).eq('owner_id', userId);\n    if (srvErr && shouldFailOnDbError()) inMemoryAssignments.delete(aId);\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n\n/**\n * List all tools for a specific server with user ownership check\n */\nexport async function listToolsForServer(userId: string, serverId: string): Promise<McpToolRecord[]> {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  let tools: McpToolRecord[] = [];\n\n  try {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('mcp_tools')\n      .select('*')\n      .eq('server_id', serverId)\n      .eq('owner_id', userId);\n\n    if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {\n      tools = data;\n    } else {\n      tools = Array.from(inMemoryTools.values()).filter(\n        (t) => t.server_id === serverId && t.owner_id === userId\n      );\n    }\n  } catch {\n    tools = Array.from(inMemoryTools.values()).filter(\n      (t) => t.server_id === serverId && t.owner_id === userId\n    );\n  }\n\n  // Attach assigned agents list\n  const assignments = await listAssignmentsForServer(serverId);\n  return tools.map((t) => {\n    const assigned = assignments.filter((a) => a.tool_id === t.id).map((a) => a.agent_id);\n    return {\n      ...t,\n      assigned_agents: assigned\n    };\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * List all assignments for a specific server\n */\nexport async function listAssignmentsForServer(serverId: string): Promise<McpToolAssignmentRecord[]> {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  try {\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\n      .from('mcp_tool_assignments')\n      .select('*')\n      .eq('server_id', serverId);\n\n    if (!error && Array.isArray(data)) {\n      return data;\n    }\n  } catch {}\n\n  return Array.from(inMemoryAssignments.values()).filter((a) => a.server_id === serverId);\n}\n\n/**\n * Toggles or sets agent access to a specific tool with fleet membership verification\n */\nexport async function setToolAssignment(\n  userId: string,\n  toolId: string,\n  agentId: string,\n  granted: boolean\n): Promise<{ success: boolean; assigned: boolean }> {\n  if (typeof granted !== 'boolean') {\n    throw new Error('granted must be a boolean');\n  }\n\n  // 1. Verify target agent belongs to operator's authentic fleet\n  const isFleetMember = await verifyAgentInOperatorFleet(userId, agentId);\n  if (!isFleetMember) {\n    throw new Error(`Target agent '${agentId}' does not belong to operator's fleet.`);\n  }\n\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n\n  // 2. Verify tool exists and belongs to this operator\n  let tool = inMemoryTools.get(toolId);\n  if (!tool) {\n    try {\n      const { data } = await supabase.from('mcp_tools').select('*').eq('id', toolId).maybeSingle();\n      tool = data;\n    } catch {}\n  }\n\n  if (!tool || tool.owner_id !== userId) {\n    throw new Error('Tool not found or unauthorized.');\n  }\n\n  if (!granted) {\n    // Revoke access\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase\n        .from('mcp_tool_assignments')\n        .delete()\n        .eq('tool_id', toolId)\n        .eq('agent_id', agentId);\n\n      if (error && shouldFailOnDbError()) {\n        throw new Error(`Database error revoking assignment: ${error.message}`);\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      if (shouldFailOnDbError()) throw err;\n    }\n\n    for (const [k, v] of inMemoryAssignments.entries()) {\n      if (v.tool_id === toolId && v.agent_id === agentId) {\n        inMemoryAssignments.delete(k);\n      }\n    }\n    return { success: true, assigned: false };\n  } else {\n    // Grant access\n    const assignmentId = crypto.randomUUID();\n    const assignmentRecord: McpToolAssignmentRecord = {\n      id: assignmentId,\n      tool_id: toolId,\n      server_id: tool.server_id,\n      owner_id: userId,\n      agent_id: agentId,\n      granted_by: userId,\n      created_at: new Date().toISOString()\n    };\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.from('mcp_tool_assignments').insert(assignmentRecord);\n      if (error && shouldFailOnDbError()) {\n        throw new Error(`Database error granting assignment: ${error.message}`);\n      }\n    } catch (err) {\n      if (shouldFailOnDbError()) throw err;\n    }\n\n    inMemoryAssignments.set(assignmentId, assignmentRecord);\n    return { success: true, assigned: true };\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Server-governed Tool Execution Proxy:\n * Verifies server runtime state, enforces agent-level tool assignment, audits execution, and validates schema\n */\nexport async function invokeAuthorizedTool(\n  caller: { userId: string; agentId: string; isMaster: boolean },\n  toolId: string,\n  args: Record<string, any>\n): Promise<{ success: boolean; result?: any; error?: string }> {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n\n  // 1. Fetch tool record\n  let tool = inMemoryTools.get(toolId);\n  if (!tool) {\n    try {\n      const { data } = await supabase.from('mcp_tools').select('*').eq('id', toolId).maybeSingle();\n      tool = data;\n    } catch {}\n  }\n\n  if (!tool) {\n    return { success: false, error: 'Tool not found.' };\n  }\n\n  if (!tool.is_enabled) {\n    await logAgentFootprint(\n      caller.userId,\n      'MCP_TOOL_INVOCATION_BLOCKED',\n      `Blocked: Tool '${tool.name}' is disabled by policy`,\n      tool.id,\n      caller.agentId\n    );\n    return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: Tool is disabled by operator policy.' };\n  }\n\n  // 2. Fetch server record\n  let server = inMemoryServers.get(tool.server_id);\n  if (!server) {\n    try {\n      const { data } = await supabase.from('mcp_servers').select('*').eq('id', tool.server_id).maybeSingle();\n      server = data;\n    } catch {}\n  }\n\n  if (!server) {\n    return { success: false, error: 'Associated MCP server not found.' };\n  }\n\n  // 3. Enforce Server Lifecycle Runtime State\n  if (server.status === 'disabled') {\n    await logAgentFootprint(\n      caller.userId,\n      'MCP_TOOL_INVOCATION_BLOCKED',\n      `Blocked: MCP server '${server.name}' is disabled`,\n      tool.id,\n      caller.agentId\n    );\n    return { success: false, error: 'Forbidden: MCP server is currently disabled.' };\n  }\n\n  if (server.status !== 'connected') {\n    await logAgentFootprint(\n      caller.userId,\n      'MCP_TOOL_INVOCATION_BLOCKED',\n      `Blocked: MCP server '${server.name}' is in '${server.status}' state`,\n      tool.id,\n      caller.agentId\n    );\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: `MCP server is not connected (current status: '${server.status}'). Re-sync connection before invoking tools.`\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 4. Strict Server-Side Authorization Check:\n  // Must have explicit grant in mcp_tool_assignments for this caller (userId or agentId)\n  const assignments = await listAssignmentsForServer(server.id);\n  const isAssigned = assignments.some(\n    (a) => a.tool_id === toolId && (a.agent_id === caller.agentId || a.agent_id === caller.userId)\n  );\n\n  if (!isAssigned) {\n    await logAgentFootprint(\n      caller.userId,\n      'MCP_TOOL_INVOCATION_BLOCKED',\n      `Unauthorized attempt by account '${caller.agentId || caller.userId}' on tool '${tool.name}'`,\n      tool.id,\n      caller.agentId\n    );\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: `Forbidden: Account '${caller.agentId || caller.userId}' is not authorized to invoke tool '${tool.name}'. Tool must be assigned in FLOOR.`\n    };\n  }\n\n  // 5. Dispatch to remote MCP server with input validation\n  const execResult = await executeRemoteMcpTool(server, tool, args);\n\n  // 6. Audit Execution Outcome\n  await logAgentFootprint(\n    caller.userId,\n    execResult.success ? 'MCP_TOOL_INVOCATION_SUCCESS' : 'MCP_TOOL_INVOCATION_FAILURE',\n    execResult.success\n      ? `Successfully executed tool '${tool.name}' on server '${server.name}'`\n      : `Execution of tool '${tool.name}' failed: ${execResult.error}`,\n    tool.id,\n    caller.agentId\n  );\n\n  return execResult;\n}\n\n/**\n * Returns tools authorized exclusively for the requesting agent\n */\nexport async function getAuthorizedToolsForAgent(\n  caller: { userId: string; agentId: string }\n): Promise<Array<{ id: string; name: string; description: string; input_schema: any; server_name: string }>> {\n  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();\n  let assignments: McpToolAssignmentRecord[] = [];\n\n  try {\n    const { data } = await supabase\n      .from('mcp_tool_assignments')\n
